cargo:c6c97242-ab4b-46a4-a437-cd52494b59._descripcion:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff UX Researcher based in the United States . We are seeking an experienced UX Research leader to shape research strategy across a major area of a technical product ecosystem, such as developer tools, AI-powered experiences, or desktop products. In this role, you will identify the most important customer questions, lead rigorous research, and ensure insights directly influence product direction and roadmap decisions. Working closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and business leadership, you will build a strong customer-driven culture while remaining actively involved in hands-on research. You will combine qualitative and quantitative methods with emerging AI-enabled research practices to uncover meaningful insights and accelerate learning. Beyond your own work, you will coach cross-functional partners, mentor fellow researchers, and help raise research standards across a globally distributed, remote-first organization.
Accountabilities
Own research strategy: Define and lead the research strategy for a major product area or multi-team program, establishing priorities, identifying target customer segments, and influencing product decisions and roadmaps. Plan research initiatives: Coordinate research across multiple teams to ensure insights are available when important decisions are being made, maintain high standards of research quality, and measure the impact of research on product outcomes. Lead mixed-methods research: Design and conduct end-to-end qualitative and quantitative studies, covering discovery, exploration, and product evaluation in complex developer, AI, and technical contexts. Synthesize complex evidence: Combine interviews, surveys, behavioral data, and findings from multiple studies to develop clear explanations that help teams understand customer needs and make informed decisions. Challenge assumptions: Help teams test established beliefs against alternative explanations, explore ambiguous problems, and develop a shared understanding of what the evidence actually supports. Advance AI-enabled research: Build reusable AI-assisted research workflows that help teams learn from more customers efficiently, while ensuring outputs are traceable, verified, and reviewed before being shared. Apply sound research judgment: Determine where AI moderation and analysis are appropriate, recognize their limitations, and distinguish reliable findings from outputs that require further validation. Coach cross-functional teams: Embed customer-driven practices into product planning and delivery, helping Product Managers, designers, and engineers incorporate customer evidence into their everyday work. Mentor researchers: Provide actionable feedback, support research craft development, contribute to onboarding, and help other researchers strengthen their methods and professional capabilities. Partner with leadership: Build trust with product area leaders, resolve disagreements through evidence, facilitate cross-functional discussions, and influence decisions without relying on formal authority. Align customer understanding: Keep Product Marketing, Sales, and field teams informed about customer needs, ensuring consistent customer insights across product development and market-facing activities. Strengthen research culture: Promote shared practices around assumptions, hypotheses, experimentation, peer review, constructive challenge, early insight sharing, and recognition of collaborative contributions. Improve research operations: Apply established operational standards where relevant, escalate situations they do not address, and provide feedback to improve processes and governance. Requirements Experience: 8+ years of UX research experience, ideally within developer products, B2B software, cloud platforms, or other technically complex product environments. Strategic ownership: Demonstrated experience owning research strategy for a product area, setting priorities, and influencing product and business leaders across multiple teams. Mixed-methods expertise: Strong qualitative research skills across discovery, interviews, and evaluation, combined with experience using surveys, quantitative methods, and behavioral data. Technical product understanding: Experience researching developer tools or other technical products, with the ability to understand complex user workflows and communicate effectively with technical audiences. Data fluency: Ability to interpret product usage and behavioral data, understand its limitations, and combine quantitative signals with qualitative evidence to guide decisions. AI research capabilities: Experience using AI-assisted research methods, with a strong focus on traceability, verification, and appropriate human judgment. Coaching and mentorship: Proven ability to coach Product Managers, designers, and engineers in customer-driven practices, as well as mentor other UX researchers. Strategic framing: Ability to turn broad or ambiguous business questions into focused, prioritized research agendas and identify the right customers to involve. Communication and influence: Exceptional storytelling and communication skills, including the ability to translate complex findings into clear recommendations, facilitate workshops, and align cross-functional stakeholders. Evidence-based mindset: Strong judgment in evaluating research confidence, testing competing hypotheses, and clearly communicating what the evidence does and does not support. Collaborative leadership: Ability to build adoption through practical guidance and partnership rather than mandates, helping teams develop sustainable customer-learning habits. Adaptability: Comfortable balancing speed and rigor according to the risk and importance of each decision, sharing emerging insights early, and staying closely involved in research execution. Work authorization: Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Applicants must already have authorization to work in the country where they will be employed. Benefits Competitive compensation: United States base salary ranging from $163,100 to $233,000, depending on experience, skills, qualifications, and location. Equity participation: Equity included for all full-time employees. Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely, with offices in Seattle and Paris available for connection and collaboration. Flexible schedule: Autonomy to manage your working hours while meeting responsibilities and delivering results. Generous time off: Paid time off, quarterly wellness days, and a dedicated end-of-year wellness break. Home office support: Assistance with setting up a comfortable and productive remote workspace. Technology stipend: Monthly allowance equivalent to US$100 net to support work-related technology needs. Learning and development: Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and other professional development opportunities. Paid parental leave: 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment. Comprehensive benefits: Medical coverage, retirement benefits, and paid holidays, with specific provisions varying by country. Team culture: Opportunities to connect and collaborate with a globally distributed team, alongside company merchandise and shared community initiatives.

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Senior Product Designer at Harvey, you’ll manage multiple projects from ideation to launch. You’ll create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes that transform complex problems into intuitive solutions. Working closely with engineers, AI researchers, product managers, and lawyers, you’ll incorporate AI in meaningful ways—crafting interfaces that help users understand, trust, and effectively guide AI outputs.

==================

* **Shape AI experiences:** Lead the charge in envisioning AI-powered experiences, including generative interfaces, intelligent automation, recommendations, and decision-support workflows.
* **Reimagine workflows:** Rethink and redesign existing workflows to create simpler, faster, and more intuitive experiences across complex enterprise use cases.

* **Influence technical direction:** Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to shape platform direction, service design, data flows, and implementation choices that affect user experience.

* **Mentor senior talent:** Coach Lead and Senior Designers, raise craft standards, and strengthen design culture across the organization.

  

**What You’ll Need**
====================

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in product design, UX, or related fields, with significant work on platform or enterprise products.
Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, or a related field (or 8 years of experience and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 6 years of experience).

Track record of delivering 0

- Supports the end-to-end design of service experiences that map across all touchpoints of the guest and team member experience journey

- Translates new technology rollouts into end-to-end service blueprints that show exactly how each change touches a guest's stay and a team member's shift.

**L35 - Brand Designer****Who We're Looking To Hire**We're looking for experienced designers, and we want those designers to bring two primary capabilities:

- Be the human who brings incredible perspective, craft, and care to the design process

- Be the human who engineers with AI to meet today's design demands around scale and efficiency

From a design perspective, we're looking for people who can bring the core fundamentals of design to variety of roles across visual design and motion. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, and that means we design for everything from quippy social posts to long-form reports to CRM activations across multiple simultaneous campaigns. One project may be campaign-focused across digital channels, the next could be designing compelling go-to-market materials for a new product launch, and the following could be creating the keynote presentation for a c-suite client at the biggest conference of their year. We want people who bring perspective on how to design something worth paying attention to, can develop that quickly and autonomously, and then can integrate with a broader creative team to make something that achieves a collective vision.

From an AI perspective, we want to hear about where you've brought AI into your process. We're not asking you where you use AI to design; we want to hire you for the craft you bring. The question will be, how are you using AI for the parts for the job like where you need to be more efficient with non-design tasks, or scale your brilliant original concept to multiple markets with different cultural preferences?

Recruiting for this role ends on December 20, 2026

**WORK YOU'LL DO**As the designer you will create the visual language that powers the customer experience, bridging the worlds of strategic vision, creative storytelling, and communication across a variety of channels and media types. You'll set the standard for compelling design and campaign messaging that engages, inspires, and produces measurable business results for our clients.

You'll partner with strategists, copywriters, technologists, and data scientists to turn brand strategies into emotionally resonant, high-performing content across digital channels. Put simply, we want high-performing individuals to add to high-performing teams.

Specific responsibilities include:

- Conceptualize, design, and refine multi-channel assets with work spanning above-the-line campaigns, below-the-line activations, brand identities, social content, presentations, digital interfaces, motion graphics, microanimations, and interactive prototypes.

- Demonstrate fluency with AI and a proactive curiosity to stay at the forefront of AI advancements, with a passion for applying cutting-edge technologies to real-world challenges.

- Translate creative briefs and business goals into actionable, engaging assets, clear visual concepts and cohesive design systems.

- Incorporate data, feedback, and best practices to optimize campaign performance.

- Be the design champion and present creative ideas to clients and internal teams, adapting to evolving feedback and real-time performance data.

- Work cross-functionally with copywriters, producers, and technologists to ensure cohesive and impactful campaign delivery.

- Stay current on trends in design, digital storytelling, social platforms, and MarTech capabilities; infuse best-in-class, platform-native thinking into everything you create.

- Contribute to business development efforts by adding creative vision and storytelling to pitches, proposals, and new client opportunities.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

- Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

- Entrepreneurial spirit, with the initiative to identify opportunities and bring new ideas to life

- Effective written and verbal communication skills

- Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

- Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

- Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

- Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

- Ability to meet deadlines

- Ability to provide clear guidance to others

**The team**Our Deloitte Digital team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions.

**Qualifications**Required

- 3+ years of experience in design with a focus on brand, digital, or content-driven marketing

- 2+ years of demonstrated competence in engineering AI solutions to support the design process

- Strong portfolio of work showcasing a variety of design types; motion design as a part of that portfolio is a must

- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

- Ability to travel up to 50% on average based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

**Preferred**

- Demonstrated proficiency in working quickly with cross-functional teams

- Experience with CRM, MarTech, or personalization tools/platforms.

- Both B2C and B2B experience across multiple channels and media types

Core Tools

- Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign: Visual design and layout

- Figma: Collaborative digital design

- Adobe After Effects: Motion graphics and animation

- Adobe Premiere: Video editing

- Microsoft PowerPoint: Presentation design

- ChatGPT, Claude, or Microsoft Copilot: AI-assisted workflows

- Adobe Firefly: AI-enabled image creation and adaptation

**Company Summary**Zoro.com is a leading eCommerce platform offering nearly 13 million tools, parts and supplies for our business customers. Launched in 2011, we brought a B2C-like experience to the B2B industry, and continue to be at the forefront of digital innovation at the intersection of technology and distribution. We have rapidly grown to over $1 billion in annual revenue and we’re just getting started!

**Job Summary:** As a UX Researcher at Zoro, you’ll work with qualitative and quantitative researchers to help bring the voice of our customers to the heart of everything we build. Your work will uncover insights that shape intuitive, meaningful digital experiences—ensuring our customers feel supported, understood, and empowered every step of the way. This is a unique opportunity to grow as a researcher while making a real impact on a business that values curiosity, empathy, and continuous learning.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

- Plan and conduct research: Independently plan, organize, and execute user research studies, using a variety of methodologies such as concept studies, diary studies, usability tests, and surveys to uncover customer needs and behaviors.

- Develop research materials: Create study assets such as test plans, discussion guides, reports, and video highlights that bring customer stories to life.

- Deliver actionable insights: Help synthesize research findings into clear, impactful insights that inform decisions across design, product, and engineering.

- Assist Lead Researchers: Collaborate with Senior and Lead researchers on complex studies and contribute to end-to-end research efforts, from study design to stakeholder presentations.

- Support recruitment and logistics: Coordinate participant recruitment and manage logistics for research activities.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

- Degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Information Science or similar fields of study

- Have at least 3 years industry experience as a UX Researcher in-house or in a consulting environment

- Demonstrated experience working with customers or end users to gather feedback

- Strong written and presentation skills

- Approximately once or twice per year, join the UXR team in conducting on-site B2B research at customers’ places of business. Visits may occur in the Chicago area or require domestic travel.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Familiarity with research tools such as Listen Labs, UserTesting, Rally and Qualtrics

- Ability to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

**Total Rewards**Zoro’s total compensation plan includes our Zoro Incentive Plan (ZIP) that is designed to foster and reward our team members for strong performance. Total compensation will be highly competitive.

In addition to competitive compensation, Zoro offers comprehensive benefits and perks including:

- Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans with coverage starting on day one of employment

- Maternity support programs, nursing benefits, and up to 14 weeks paid leave for birth parents and up to 4 weeks paid leave for non-birth parents. We also support growing your family through access to adoption assistance program

- 6 free sessions each year with a licensed therapist and Wellhub portal membership to support your mental and emotional wellbeing

- At least 18 paid time off days annually for full-time employees and 6 company holidays per year

- 6% company contribution to a 401K Retirement Savings Plan each pay period, no employee contribution required

- Tuition reimbursement, student loan refinancing and access to financial counseling, education, and tools

- Charitable Gift Program - match gift to an eligible educational, cultural, community health, and human service organizations

- Employee discounts and admission to various civic and cultural institutions around Chicago

- Zoro office perks including coffee bar, beer on tap, unlimited snacks, access to the onsite gym, and incredible city skyline views

For additional information and details regarding our benefits and our parent company, W. W. Grainger, please click on the link here.

The pay range provided is not a guarantee of compensation. The range listed reflects the expected base pay for this position at the time of posting, based on the role's job grade. Actual compensation may vary depending on factors such as location, relevant experience and individual qualifications.

Illinois

$78,900—$131,600 USD

**Our Culture**Zoro was founded in 2011 with a simple idea: make it easy for businesses to get the tools, parts, and supplies they need to keep things running. We've grown by staying curious, moving quickly, and solving everyday challenges in smart, practical ways. Backed by W.W. Grainger and inspired by our endless assortment business model, we’re on a clear path toward our next big milestone: $2 billion in revenue—and beyond.

At Zoro, we don’t just follow a playbook—we help build it. You’ll get to work on real problems with a supportive team that shares ideas freely, learns from each other, and celebrates wins together. Our culture is grounded in values that guide how we show up every day: **Winning & Learning Together**, **Being Customer Obsessed**, **Being Transparent**, and **Taking Ownership**. We don’t have all the answers, but we’re always asking good questions.

Zoro’s culture has been recognized by Fortune, Best Places to Work, and Built In Chicago—but the recognition we care about most comes from our team members, who make this place what it is.

We also know that flexibility matters. Our hybrid work model gives you space to focus and the flexibility to live your life — asking team members to be onsite at least two days a week. Our Chicago HQ (right above Ogilvie Transportation Center in the Accenture Tower) is always open and ready for connection, collaboration, or just a good cup of coffee.

At Zoro, we’re growing fast toward big aspirations — and we’re continuously excited about the new challenges we get to solve together.

One North is looking for a Design System Designer with strong visual design craft, deep Figma expertise, and experience creating and maintaining scalable digital design systems.

This role will support the development, evolution, and adoption of design systems that enable teams to deliver consistent, accessible, and high-quality digital experiences across enterprise organizations.

As part of the Design Systems team, this individual will work closely with Design System Leads, designers, developers, and client stakeholders to build and maintain component libraries, establish reusable patterns, document standards, and support the successful implementation of design systems. The role may also contribute to Figma migrations, design system optimization, and training initiatives that help organizations improve the efficiency and quality of their design workflows.

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented, collaborative designer who enjoys creating scalable solutions, solving complex design challenges, and exploring how emerging technologies, including AI, can improve design system development and operations.

This role will ideally be based in the Chicago area, but we are open to remote locations across the U.S. and Canada.

**Responsibilities**

- Create, refine, and maintain scalable design systems, including component libraries, styles, variables, design tokens, and reusable patterns.

- Build and optimize Figma libraries using best practices for components, variants, Auto Layout, variables, and library architecture.

- Develop and maintain clear design system documentation, usage guidelines, and standards that support consistency and adoption.

- Support the migration and consolidation of design assets, libraries, and components into Figma, ensuring quality, consistency, and scalability.

- Collaborate with Design System Leads and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities to expand, improve, and evolve design systems.

- Partner with designers and engineers to ensure components and patterns are practical, accessible, and aligned with implementation needs.

- Support design system governance by contributing to component reviews, quality assurance, and ongoing library maintenance.

- Help establish scalable approaches to responsive behavior, component states, interaction patterns, and accessibility standards.

- Contribute to design system audits and assessments to identify inconsistencies, gaps, and opportunities for optimization.

- Support design system adoption through documentation, training materials, workshops, and collaboration with client teams.

- Explore and leverage AI tools to improve design system workflows, including component creation, documentation, auditing, and operational efficiency.

- Collaborate with designers, developers, strategists, and client stakeholders to ensure design systems meet organizational and product needs.

- Participate in internal and client working sessions, presenting design system solutions and communicating design decisions.

- Incorporate feedback from Design System Leads, Managers, and cross-functional partners to continuously improve deliverables.

- Ensure design system assets and standards align with accessibility requirements and inclusive design principles.

**When Packing Your Bags, Please Bring**

- Strong understanding of design system principles, including scalability, reusability, consistency, and maintainability.

- Advanced Figma expertise, including components, variants, Auto Layout, Variables, styles, and shared libraries.

- Experience creating, maintaining, or contributing to design systems and component libraries.

- Strong visual design fundamentals, with attention to typography, spacing, hierarchy, layout, and interaction states.

- Understanding of design tokens, component architecture, and the relationship between design and development.

- Knowledge of responsive design principles and how components adapt across devices and screen sizes.

- Familiarity with accessibility standards, including WCAG guidelines and inclusive design practices.

- Ability to create clear, organized documentation that helps teams effectively understand and use design system assets.

- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality, consistency, and scalable design solutions.

- Interest in AI-enabled design workflows and emerging technologies that can improve design system development and operations.

- Comfort working in collaborative, multidisciplinary environments with designers, developers, and client stakeholders.

- Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and openness to feedback.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and contribute to projects with evolving requirements.

**Your Weapons (wield Them Wisely)**

- Required:

- A portfolio demonstrating hands-on experience creating or contributing to design systems, including component libraries, reusable patterns, Figma architecture, or system documentation.

- 3 or more years of experience in Product Design, UX/UI Design, or Design Systems work in an agency, consultancy, or in-house environment

- Experience creating and maintaining reusable design components and patterns that support consistency and scalability

- Working knowledge of responsive design and front-end collaboration

- Nice to have:

- Experience supporting Sketch-to-Figma migrations, library consolidation, or design tool transitions.

- Familiarity with design token structures, token management tools, and design-to-code workflows.

- Experience contributing to design system governance, adoption, or operational processes.

- Experience developing design system training materials, facilitating workshops, or supporting designer enablement.

- Familiarity with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, or component-based frameworks.

- Experience using AI tools or automation to improve design system creation, maintenance, documentation, or workflows.

- Experience working with enterprise-scale design systems across multiple products, platforms, or teams.

**Benefits**

- Our comprehensive benefits program includes Blue Cross Blue Shield PPO Health coverage, as well as a health savings account with employer-funded contributions.

- We also offer Dental and Vision insurance. All of our full-time employees are eligible for Life/AD&D insurance and Short/Long Term Disability insurance free of cost, with the option to add additional voluntary coverage if desired.

- One North’s 401(k) plan allows employees to save for retirement through pre- or post-tax contributions along with employer-matched funds for maximized savings potential.

- Our Transportation Benefits enable employees to also make pre-tax contributions to pay for parking and public transit needs.

- We know how important unwinding can be for inspiration, innovation and productivity. Our full-time employees earn 4 weeks of paid time off, in addition to company paid holidays. Employees begin to accrue additional time off once they reach their 3-year and 10-year anniversaries with the business.

- One North also understands how critical it is for parents to bond with their new additions. We provide paid Parental and Primary Caregiver Leave to assist and support employees who experience a new birth, adoption or foster placement of a child.

- We also offer an Employee Perks Program that offers member-only discounts and corporate rates on everything from pizza and the zoo, to movie tickets, car rentals, and hotels.

We reserve the right to pay above or below the base salary range of $75,400-$113,000 based on factors unrelated to sex, race, or any other protected classification.

Additional earnings may be available through incentive programs like annual bonuses, profit sharing, etc.

Please click on the following link to learn more about our full-time internal employment benefits: https://www.teksystems.com/en/careers/benefits.

The expected posting close date is December 4, 2026.

- Clicking the Apply now button will redirect you to apply on TEKsystems.com.

Apply now

**Blacksmith Agency**

- Design

- Full time, your only job

- Remote (Latin America)

**About The Role**Blacksmith Agency builds websites for clients across the US. As Design Systems Designer at Blacksmith, you build the Figma design systems our team ships every client site from: tokens, variables, modes and component libraries that developers build from without asking you questions.

This is a full-time, in-house seat on our team, and it has to be your only job. If you run freelance clients, a studio or agency side work, or plan to keep them, this role is not a fit.

**What You Will Own**

- Token architecture in Figma: variables, modes and semantic naming, from primitives to semantic to component level.

- Component libraries that hold up across an entire site, not just a homepage.

- Handoff and documentation that let a developer or a build pipeline execute the system without questions.

- Several client brands at once, each distinct, with the same structure underneath.

**What You Bring**

- 4+ years as a product, UI or design systems designer, ideally on an in-house team.

- A design system you personally built in Figma with variables, modes and tokens, and can walk us through in detail.

- Experience handing a system to developers and keeping Figma and code in step.

- Strong spoken English. You will present and defend your system on live calls with a US team.

- Full-time availability overlapping US business hours.

**Not a fit if**

- You freelance or run a studio and would keep clients alongside this job.

- Your work is mainly page layouts or marketing pages, without tokens or variables.

**How To Apply**Apply in two minutes at the link, then take a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment with the same email. Qualified applicants then do a 20 minute recorded interview in English about the systems they have built.

Bridging existing UI design components with real-world and hardware-derived data, you'll bring logical rigor to product scenarios before they reach development and QA. -  5+ years of experience in product analysis or business analysis.

cargo:3858a8c9-0c64-4419-a783-f0e58e3618._descripcion:
**About us**
------------

The physical and digital worlds are merging. Vehicles, medical devices, industrial systems, critical infrastructure: security hasn't kept pace. AI is accelerating everything, from the capabilities of the systems we depend on to the sophistication of the threats targeting them. A software vulnerability can now have physical consequences. A physical breach can compromise entire digital ecosystems. Billions of devices operate with little to no protection, and traditional approaches can't keep up. Not at this scale, not at this speed, and not across this diversity of systems.  
Exein exists to solve this. We build the security layer for a world where physical and digital threats are no longer separate problems, from runtime protection on embedded devices to cloud-native platforms that analyze, protect, and prove compliance across entire device fleets. We're not patching the old model. We're building security from the core out.

**The role**
------------

We're looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager to lead 1-2 key product verticals within the Exein platform, covering our core products — Analyzer and Runtime — and setting new benchmarks in physical AI security.  
**This is a high-ownership role for someone who has already built and scaled products within a cybersecurity scale-up in Europe or elsewhere.** We are specifically looking with someone with a demonstrated founder mentality, for example ex founders, early product hires, or a first/sole Product Manager who has operated in a fast-growing cybersecurity company and knows what it takes to turn complex technical challenges into successful products.  
This role requires a business innovation mindset applied to a highly technical context. You will drive a dedicated product vertical end-to-end, with accountability for its strategic direction and execution across the associated roadmap pillars — from customer discovery and problem definition to product strategy, prioritization, development, launch, and continuous improvement.  
You will work closely with the head of product to provide input on overall product strategy and the platform roadmap to meet the needs of your vertical. Working across a highly cross-functional environment, you will collaborate closely with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Security Research, AI, and Go-to-Market teams. You will work as an integral part of Exein's Product organization, collaborating closely with the Product Team based at our headquarters in Rome, Italy. The role reports to the Head of Product, who reports to the CTO. While this role is based in Europe, occasional travel to Rome will be required to ensure strong alignment, close collaboration, and shared product ownership.  
We need someone who thrives in ambiguity, operates with exceptional autonomy, and can take a product from zero to market with limited resources. Someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and is comfortable navigating highly technical environments. Nice to have qualities are an interest in developing product operations and practices, as the product organization is growing fast.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Drive a product vertical end-to-end:** define its vision, evidence, GTM strategy,, and execution across all related product pillars, taking full accountability from discovery through launch and beyond.
* **Build and scale products:** identify opportunities, validate customer problems, translate complex technical requirements into product solutions, and bring new capabilities from concept to market.
* Contribute to the evolution of the Exein platform and its core products (Analyzer and Runtime), setting new standards for quality, security coverage, and user experience.
* Act as the voice of the customer — firmware engineers, security teams, and compliance owners — ensuring customer insights and market needs directly inform product decisions.
* Define and drive product strategy across key areas such as CVE detection and remediation, SBOM and compliance workflows (including CRA readiness), and fleet-wide runtime protection.
* Work hands-on with Engineering, Security Research, AI, Sales, Marketing, and Go-to-Market teams to translate product vision into clear priorities, technical requirements, and successful releases.
* Collaborate closely with the CTO, head of product, and the rest of the product Team at Exein's Rome HQ, ensuring alignment across product strategy, roadmap priorities, and execution.
* Navigate technical complexity and competing priorities, making sound product decisions in fast-moving environments with limited resources.
* Continuously improve user journeys across the platform, from firmware upload to vulnerability analysis and incident triage.
* Define and monitor product KPIs, measuring adoption, engagement, retention, and business impact.

**Requirements**
----------------

* **Mandatory: Previous experience in a cybersecurity context .** We are looking for someone who has experienced the challenges of building and scaling cybersecurity products.
* **5+ years of relevant product experience**, ideally as a **founder, first/sole Product Manager, or early product leader** with significant end-to-end ownership.
* Proven track record of taking products from zero to market, building with limited resources, and making high-impact decisions independently.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity products, ideally in B2B environments, with the ability to engage credibly with security engineers and technical stakeholders.
* Strong technical fluency and the ability to understand complex architectures, software development processes, and embedded/Linux systems concepts.
* Demonstrated ability to own a product vertical and drive multiple interconnected roadmap pillars from discovery to delivery and launch.
* Highly autonomous, entrepreneurial, and execution-oriented mindset. Comfortable operating without predefined processes and creating structure where needed.
* Proven ability to work closely with engineering teams, challenge assumptions, define scope, and drive delivery.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS context
* Proven ability to integrate agentic / AI tools into the product management practice
* Experience with making AI-first products or releasing AI/agentic features in a real product
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence technical teams, executive stakeholders, and customers.
* English fluency is mandatory.
* Based in Europe and available to occasionally travel to Exein's headquarters in Rome, Italy.

#### ***Nice to have***

* Experience in physical AI, embedded security, IoT security, device security, or product security.
* Understanding of firmware build systems (Yocto, Buildroot), containers, or kernel-level technologies such as eBPF.
* Experience applying AI capabilities within technical product workflows.
* Experience scaling a cybersecurity product from early-stage development to enterprise adoption.

**Why join us**
---------------

* Drive a strategic product vertical and directly influence its vision, delivery , and market success.
* Work on complex, technically challenging products addressing a rapidly evolving market.
* Operate with autonomy, make meaningful product decisions, and see your work translate into products used by customers worldwide.
* Collaborate with engineers, security researchers, commercial teams, and product leaders who are passionate about building world-class technology.
* Work closely with the head of product and CTO at our Rome HQ while helping scale Exein's product capabilities across Europe and beyond.
Work at Europe's latest unicorn* Contribute to a company building the next generation of embedded and device security.

**Location:** Europe **-** Occasional travel to Rome (HQ), Italy

**Salary range:** €60-80K

*Exein is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We evaluate all applications fairly regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, background, or orientation.*

FDNA is a pioneer in AI-powered phenotyping and precision health, dedicated to expediting the diagnosis and care management of rare genetic and developmental disorders. Used across more than 10,000 medical centers in over 130 countries, our ecosystem and products bridges the gap between concerned parents, healthcare providers, and life sciences organization.

**About The Role**We are seeking a strategic, execution-driven **Head of Product** based in Latin America to own the end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and delivery across FDNA's clinical, patient-facing, and interoperability product lines. Reporting directly to the executive leadership team (working closely with our Chief Product & Technology Officer, Chief Medical Officer, and AI Research leads), you will translate cutting-edge multimodal AI capabilities into intuitive, compliant, and clinically impactful products tailored primarily for the US healthcare ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Product Strategy & Lifecycle Ownership: Define and execute the multi-product roadmap across Face2Gene, Family Health Checker, and FDNA's Provider/Pharma Data Clearinghouse, balancing clinician utility, patient engagement, and B2B/life sciences monetization.

- US Clinical Workflow & EHR Integration: Architect seamless product experiences that fit naturally into US pediatric, genetic, and primary care clinical workflows, driving HL7/FHIR-based EHR integrations, digital intake, and specialist referral pathways

- Regulatory & Compliance Governance: Partner with Legal, Clinical, and Security teams to ensure all product features strictly adhere to HIPAA privacy/security mandates, de-identification protocols, and FDA Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) / Clinical Decision Support (CDS) regulatory boundaries

- AI-to-Product Translation: Collaborate closely with AI/ML engineering and medical genetics teams to productize novel multimodal models (facial analysis, video, audio, and clinical notes) while maintaining high standards for clinical transparency, bias mitigation, and explainability

- Cross-Functional & Nearshore Leadership: Lead, mentor, and scale a distributed product management and UX/UI design function across time zones, fostering tight alignment between LATAM-based teams, US-based commercial/clinical stakeholders, and global R&D centers

- Customer & Market Discovery: Conduct continuous discovery with US health systems, pediatric specialists, genetic counselors, patient advocacy groups, and pharma/CRO partners to validate product-market fit and measure clinical and commercial outcomes

**Requirements**

- Experience: 6+ years of progressive product management experience, including at least 2+ years in a senior leadership role (Director or Head of Product) owning multiple interconnected software products

- Dedicated US Healthcare Exposure (Mandatory): ≥50% of your career (3+ years minimum) must be directly dedicated to building and scaling products for the US healthcare market, demonstrating hands-on mastery of:

- HIPAA Compliance & Data Privacy: Managing PHI/PII, BAAs, SOC 2 standards, and de-identified real-world data (RWD) exchange

- FDA & SaMD Parameters: Navigating FDA guidance on Clinical Decision Support (CDS) software, SaMD classifications, and non-diagnostic informational labeling.

- US EHR Integrations: Hands-on experience shipping integrations with major US EHRs (e.g., Epic, Oracle Cerner, athenahealth) utilizing HL7, FHIR, SMART on FHIR, or clearinghouse APIs

- US Clinical Workflows: Deep familiarity with US provider intake, referral management, care coordination, and specialty clinical environments

- Location & Alignment: Residing in any Latin American country with strong overlap with US Eastern/Central business hours and fluent, executive-level English communication skills

- AI / Data-Intensive Product Track Record: Proven experience bringing data-heavy, algorithmic, or AI/ML-powered healthcare applications from concept to commercial adoption

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Prior experience with rare diseases, clinical genomics, pediatrics, digital diagnostics, or life sciences/CRO real-world data platforms

- Background working in high-growth healthtech startups or distributed international R&D organizations

- Familiarity with consumer-to-provider ("digital front door") patient acquisition and engagement funnels

CV/Resume submissions **MUST** be in English.

Exposure to cutting-edge technologies, open-source tools, and emerging AI-driven ecosystems. Opportunities to attend industry conferences and connect with colleagues from around the world. **Building the Future of Open Finance**Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

**The team**Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.

The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.

**The opportunity**

- Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)

- Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases

- Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against

- Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale

- Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding

- Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business

- Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers

- Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

**What You Bring**

- 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers

- Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them

- Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect

- Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components

- Clear, structured writing. You turn complex system designs into docs that product, compliance and business stakeholders can all act on

- Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority

- Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

**Nice to haves**

- Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house

- Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms

- Familiarity with crypto, stablecoins or on/off-ramps

- Experience working across multiple regulated legal entities or licensing regimes

Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

**About Teamup**
----------------

Teamup is a customizable shared calendar for business. 5 million people use a Teamup calendar every month to organize schedules, resources, and teams, from room bookings to complex job schedules for field crews.

**About the role**
------------------

Most people meet Teamup through a calendar someone shared with them. It solves their problem, and they come back. That sharing flywheel already drives Teamup's growth. This role builds on it: getting new admins to value faster, turning more viewers into admins, and making the move from free to paid clear and easy.

This is a full-stack growth product manager role, and Teamup's first dedicated to growth and reports to the CEO. You'll work amongst engineers and a dedicated support team, solving customer problems. As an independent self-starter, you find the problem, build the prototype, write the code with AI, open the pull request, ship it, and measure what it does. This role is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the Eastern time zone of the USA.

You'll own:

* **Time to value:** the first session for every new admin, from signup to a shared calendar that solves their problem.
* **Activation:** the definition, the events, the reporting, and the number.
* **The referral loop:** how a shared calendar turns viewers into admins, including viewers on their phones.
* **The upgrade path:** free plan limits, upgrade prompts, and the moment a free calendar becomes paid.
* **The AI onboarding agent** that guides new admins.
* **The experiment cadence:** what gets tested, what ships, and what gets cut.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Talk with customers and read support conversations every week to find where people get stuck.
* Build prototypes to test ideas quickly.
* Write code with AI, open pull requests, and ship to production alongside the engineering team.
* Design with AI tools.
* Instrument the funnel and build the reporting you run the work from.

**The numbers you'll move**
---------------------------

Activation rate, time to value, viewer-to-admin conversion, and free-to-paid conversion.

**You'll be a great fit if**
----------------------------

* You have built and shipped products yourself
* You have 5+ years in growth or product at a s**elf-serve software company** where customers sign up and pay without talking to sales.
* You have owned onboarding, activation, an upgrade path, or an in-product share loop, with results you can name.
* You write production code with AI, open pull requests, write SQL, and instrument events yourself.
* You design with AI.
* You stay close to the customer and change the product based on what you hear.
* You are a self-starter who works independently alongside engineering and support.
* You have done this at a small company or as an early hire.
* You move fast.

Are you passionate about building innovative healthcare products that help improve patient outcomes and support healthcare professionals in making informed decisions?

Do you enjoy working at the intersection of customer insight, technology, and AI while collaborating with global teams to bring impactful product solutions to market?

**About our Team**

Elsevier Health applies innovation, facilitates insights, and helps drive more informed decision-making for our customers across global health. We support health providers by providing accessible, trusted evidence-based information; prepare more medical and nursing students with effective tools and resources; provide insights that help clinicians improve patient outcomes; and support a more personalized and localized healthcare experience. All for the benefit of every patient.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a curious, customer-focused, and technology-oriented Senior Product Manager to help develop innovative healthcare products primarily serving customers in the United States. In this role, you will work closely with customers, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to identify meaningful problems, translate market insights into product opportunities, and guide solutions from discovery through delivery. You will play a key role in exploring AI-enabled approaches and rapid prototyping to create impactful products that improve healthcare experiences and outcomes.

**Responsibilities**

- Own product initiatives from customer discovery and problem definition through development, launch, and continuous improvement.

- Develop a strong understanding of customers, users, market dynamics, and emerging opportunities within healthcare.

- Translate customer problems and market insights into clear product requirements, priorities, and roadmaps.

- Partner closely with engineering, technology, design, and business stakeholders to develop high-quality product solutions.

- Identify opportunities to incorporate AI and emerging technologies into products and product-development processes.

- Experiment with AI-assisted prototyping, including approaches such as vibe coding, to rapidly explore and communicate product concepts.

- Use prototypes, customer insights, and data to test assumptions before committing significant development resources.

- Manage priorities and trade-offs while balancing customer value, business objectives, technical feasibility, and regulatory considerations.

**Requirements**

- Product management experience with demonstrated ownership of products, features, or significant product initiatives.

- Strong understanding of the product-development lifecycle, including discovery, prioritization, development, launch, and iteration.

- Demonstrated ability to understand customer needs and translate them into actionable product opportunities.

- Experience working with products, customers, or organizations serving the US market.

- Strong technology orientation and confidence partnering with engineering and technical teams.

- Curiosity about AI, emerging technologies, and new approaches to product development.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and prioritization skills.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, and cross-functional collaboration capabilities.

**Work in a Way That Works for You**

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

**Working Pattern**

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

**About the Business**

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

About the role Product managers at Mitratech are revenue engineers. You own how your products grow revenue and keep customers successful. You choose the capabilities that matter most, either because they help sales and renewals close or because they make customers more successful. You turn those choices into requirements engineering builds from, then work with customers, support, sales and engineering until the results show up in revenue and retention. You report into the Product Management organization and work with a distributed engineering and design team across several countries. What you will do Find the revenue opportunity. Talk to customers and admins every week, read usage and satisfaction data, join win-loss and renewal reviews, and write down the problem with the revenue case behind it. Work with sales and customer success to find where a missing capability costs deals or renewals, and decide what to build in response. Keep the roadmap for your area current and explain what is on it, what is not, and the revenue reason for each choice. Define the problem worth solving and the job the customer is trying to get done, with the evidence behind it. Give design and engineering a clear enough picture of the problem and the outcome that they know what to build and can tell when it works. Plan releases with engineering, estimate effort together, and manage scope as the release moves. Represent the customer in engineering, design, support and sales conversations. Demonstrate what you are building to customers and to the wider organization, collect their feedback, and secure agreement from stakeholders before a release goes to market. Give sales, support and customer success what they need to sell and support each release: positioning, demos and answers to the questions customers ask. Define the metrics for your area (revenue, retention, adoption and customer satisfaction), report on them, and check each release against the revenue case you made for it. What you bring 5 or more years of product management experience, including at least 3 in business-to-business enterprise SaaS. A record of shipping software that real customers use, and the artifacts to show how you worked: requirements, roadmaps, discovery notes, metrics. Experience working with engineering teams across time zones. A record of tying product decisions to revenue, retention or expansion, with the numbers to show it. Comfort with product analytics and with turning data into a decision. Written and spoken English at a professional level. You will write requirements and present in English every day. A bachelor's degree in business, computer science, engineering, information systems, economics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Preferred Experience in HR technology, such as performance management, learning, applicant tracking, compensation, payroll or HCM. Experience adding AI-assisted features to an enterprise product. An MBA or master's degree. Familiarity with tools such as Jira and Productboard. How Mitratech will assess the role Mitratech's product management career path defines the Product Manager level as working independently on problem definition, discovery, release planning, stakeholder alignment, metrics and influence, and as developing the skills of strategy, pricing, negotiation and customer engagement. **Job Description****Why GM Financial?**GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. We also offer commercial lending products to dealers to help them finance and grow their businesses.

At GM Financial, our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes new ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive.

**Our Purpose:** We pioneer the innovations that move and connect people to what matters.

This position will be posted until filled.

**Responsibilities****About the Role**Are you interested in building partnerships, managing and evolving GM Financial’s digital experiences to optimize technology and processes to improve our customer and dealer experiences? The Digital Product Management Team within IO Customer Experience is leading the way to provide value and remarkable service to our customers by creating seamless experiences across multiple channels and touchpoints to ensure the best business outcomes.

The Digital Product Manager is responsible for driving customer value through the establishment of a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap that aligns with customer needs, technology trends and GMF Strategy. The ideal candidate is results driven and has expertise in developing and executing strategies that support digital product development aligning to the company’s vision and strategic goals. Key responsibilities focus on customer observation and understanding, understand data and analytics, developing relationships with multiple stakeholders, capturing, and representing GMF’s business needs both internally and with third parties, leveraging insights and trends to facilitate change and define the future for GMF Products, driving adequate governance around the lifecycle of a product including change and vendor management.

As a Digital Product Manager, you’ll support teams responsible for systems used by our distributed operational teams and all phases of the Customer Journey (Consider, Acquire & Serve), and partner closely with innovation and transformation initiatives to ensure proper prioritization and future-proofing capabilities, while driving value on day-to-day operations of your digital product.

**In This Role You Will**

- Understand and evangelize the vision, strategic priorities and goals of the organization, translating them into a roadmap of features and enhancements that provide remarkable customer experiences.

- Lead the high-level prioritization of initiatives, aligning experiences across channels and touchpoints to ensure the best business results.

- Plan, develop and implement strategy in partnership with IT & Data for strategic long-term roadmaps, through understanding the business and customer’s changing needs, including the changing financial, regulatory, compliance, operational-risk, and cybersecurity environment, along with the business processes that are/will be required to deliver trusted and reliable experiences.

- Communicate and collaborate effectively with GM Financial technology teams, strategic vendors, delivery partners, Architecture, Data Science, Design/UX, Analytics, and Customer Experience Management teams.

- Define plans that assess internal and external resource requirements, technology needs, interdependencies, and timelines. Contribute to the best roadmap definition to accommodate operational needs from an IO perspective, focusing on target operating models and operational efficiencies, resiliency and future transformation of Servicing.

- Support business requirement definition for all solutions within scope and interdependencies. Liaise with other functional / departmental managers to ensure there is full visibility of organizational developments, objectives, purposes, and achievements.

- Interface with business partners to create cohesive business processes and required digital solutions, enabling customer-facing channels, operational teams, and other products through reusable contract management and servicing capabilities.

- Strong understanding and experience with Design Thinking process, conducting user interviews, creating and evaluating prototypes.

- Strong understanding of Hypothesis Driven Development.

- Experience working with UX team members or be willing to take a first pass at designs.

- Drive the product roadmap and participate in end-to-end product life cycle development based on market research, analytics, and business requirements.

- Define the product strategy and lead the execution of a roadmap of features and experiences that exceed customer expectations and meet business objectives and key results (OKR’s)

- Engages with Product Managers and Product Owners for the correct execution of the Product Management routines and discipline.

- Manage product performance by defining and measuring Objectives & Key Results (OKRs), product analytics, operational processes, and systems to measure results.

**Qualifications****What makes You an ideal candidate?**

- Fluent in English

- Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is desirable

- Experience working with operational teams, preferably large and distributed teams

- Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with proven ability to negotiate an influence across functions and regions.

- High adaptability to changing priorities, regulatory shifts, and market dynamics.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, fostering transparency and alignment.

- Commitment to ethical conduct, data integrity, and compliance with internal policies

- Proactive problem-solver with a bias for action and continuous improvement.

- Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity in complex environments.

- Ability to dive into performance measurements with teams to help optimize and find key insights into performance.

- Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

- Intellectual curiosity to learn and ask questions to find creative ways to answer complex questions with data

- Strong business acumen, understanding of business models and market dynamic to guide product decisions

**Additional Knowledge And Skills**Working effectively within an AI enabled environment:

- Ability to use AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to support daily work

- Skills in evaluating AI outputs for accuracy, compliance, and bias

- Experience integrating AI into workflows to improve efficiency or insights

- Familiarity with AI assisted research, summarization, and content generation

- Understanding of responsible AI use, including ethics and data protection

**Work Experience & Education**

- Experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner or working with Agile methodologies

- Experience and working knowledge of GM Financial Platforms and Digital Solutions.

- Bachelor’s degree

The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken's Compliance Operations teams, including the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), investigations and enhanced due diligence, are the front line of how Kraken detects and responds to financial crime. The systems they run on sit within Core Services Product, alongside the engineering teams who build them. That covers alert ingestion, case management, investigator tooling and a growing set of automation and AI tools. This role owns the product for that investigation platform. That means how an alert is created, enriched, grouped and suppressed. How it becomes a case. How an investigator reaches and documents a decision. And how every step is evidenced to a regulator or auditor. You'll start with the FIU, where the workflows are most complex and the audit bar is highest, then extend the platform across Compliance Operations. The opportunity Own the investigation-platform roadmap end to end. Sequence it and defend it, and re-sequence it when a regulator or the RCO raises a P0. Define "done" before build starts. Write phased deliverables and acceptance criteria that Compliance signs off, and hold the line when scope moves. Get requirements in before engineering starts. Build the intake between Compliance policy, monitoring rules and case management so that changes don't reach investigators before their workflows are ready. Understand the process before building. Reconcile policy and SOPs against what investigators actually do and what the system actually does. Know the difference between a process fix and a technical one, and say which requests are in scope for engineering. Understand the pipeline well enough to challenge it: ingestion, profile and transaction resolution, suppression and grouping logic, and reconciliation between vendor output and case management. Be able to walk an auditor through it with live examples. Make auditability a first-class requirement: audit trail, data lineage, evidence retention, reviewer attribution, change-management controls, and validation of filtering and suppression logic. Ship automation and AI into regulated workflows with controls that hold up in Compliance, IT and privacy audits. That means human-in-the-loop design, explainability and ongoing monitoring. Run the operating rhythm: a shared forum with engineering and adjacent product managers, a regular stakeholder update, and one delivery status that everyone reads the same way. What You Bring 4+ years of product management, including 2+ years on financial-crime systems such as transaction monitoring, investigations, case management, KYC/EDD or sanctions screening. Working knowledge of how an AML programme is examined, including the questions regulators, internal audit and model validation ask about monitoring, filing and control systems. The technical fluency to go deep on data flows and system design with engineers, and to spot when a design won't meet the requirement. A track record of shipping internal tools or operational platforms that measurably changed how an operations team works. Clear, concise writing, from PRDs and phase plans to audit walkthroughs and executive updates. The judgement to tell a senior stakeholder a timeline isn't realistic because the requirements aren't written yet, and to keep the relationship intact. Nice to haves Direct FIU experience, such as alert disposition, SAR/STR filing or leading investigators. Crypto or digital-asset experience, such as blockchain analytics, wallet-level transaction analysis or focal vs counterparty logic. Experience shipping AI or ML into a regulated investigative workflow, including the control design. Build-vs-buy and vendor evaluation for monitoring or case-management tooling. Experience with programmes that span jurisdictions (UK, EU/MiCA, US). Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. High adaptability to changing priorities, regulatory shifts, and market dynamics. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, fostering transparency and alignment. Commitment to ethical conduct, data integrity, and compliance with internal policies Proactive problem-solver with a bias for action and continuous improvement. Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity in complex environments. Ability to dive into performance measurements with teams to help optimize and find key insights into performance. cargo:3858a8c9-0c64-4419-a783-f0e58e3618._descripcion:
How will you use AI, emerging technologies, and product leadership to shape the future of healthcare for customers across the United States?

Are you excited by the opportunity to turn customer insight, market opportunities, and innovative technologies into products that deliver measurable impact at scale?

**About our Team**

Elsevier Health applies innovation, facilitates insights, and helps drive more informed decision-making for our customers across global health. We support health providers by providing accessible, trusted evidence-based information; prepare more medical and nursing students with effective tools and resources; provide insights that help clinicians improve patient outcomes; and support a more personalized and localized healthcare experience. All for the benefit of every patient.

**About the Role**

As a Principal Product Manager, you will lead the strategy and delivery of innovative healthcare products serving the US market. Working at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and AI, you will identify new opportunities, guide product innovation from discovery through delivery, and collaborate across teams to create solutions that address meaningful customer challenges.

**Responsibilities**

- Lead complex product innovation initiatives from customer discovery and opportunity identification through product definition, development, and market delivery

- Develop a deep understanding of customer needs, market dynamics, user challenges, and emerging opportunities within healthcare

- Define product strategy and priorities based on customer insights, market opportunities, business objectives, and technology capabilities

- Partner closely with engineering and technology teams to transform product concepts into scalable solutions

- Identify opportunities to apply AI and emerging technologies across product development processes and customer-facing products

- Use rapid experimentation, AI-assisted prototyping, and iterative approaches to validate ideas and accelerate learning

- Provide senior product leadership across cross-functional programs and influence stakeholders across product, technology, and business teams

- Evaluate opportunities within regulated healthcare environments while balancing customer needs, innovation goals, and business priorities

**Requirements**

- Experience owning complex products or product portfolios and driving product strategy

- Experience leading product innovation initiatives from concept through delivery

- Strong customer focus with the ability to translate customer needs and market insights into product opportunities

- Experience supporting products or services for customers in the United States market

- Strong technology orientation and ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams

- Experience exploring or applying AI and emerging technologies within the product development lifecycle

- Strong strategic thinking and ability to bring clarity to complex or ambiguous opportunities

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills within global, cross-functional environments

**Work in a Way That Works for You**

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

**Working Pattern**

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

**About the Business**

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.
