**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Technical Product Manager** to manage the product roadmap and delivery of Cloud and Platform Security solutions, working closely with engineering teams and stakeholders across a large enterprise organization.

The mandatory requirements are **5+ years in Product Management**, expertise in **Cloud, Platform, or Workload Security**, a technical background, public or private cloud product delivery experience, and an upper-intermediate English level. Experience in large financial companies is a plus.

**What you will do**

- Lead customer and stakeholder discovery, and partnership.

- Drive the management, socialization, and evolution of the product roadmap.

- Enable the engineering team to work in an agile manner, with clear direction and feedback on priorities and deliverables.

- Ensure the end-to-end delivery of the product roadmap with collaboration across teams, including the identification and communication of dependencies and risks.

- Ensure the individual product strategy is aligned and integrated within our wider organization strategy.

- Understand the industry and market your product is in and apply that knowledge to customer interactions and the product roadmap.

- Build and maintain customer community and engagement for the product.

- Champion the team's customer successes.

**Must haves**

- **5+ years of experience in Product Management.**

- Experience in **Cloud, Platform, and Workload Security**.

- Deep understanding of Cloud security capabilities and approach for securing and monitoring cloud. This is needed to appropriately support the engineering team and have productive interaction with them.

- A technical background that enables probing conversations with customers and discussion with the product engineering team.

- Experience in delivering products/solutions/services in **Public / Private Cloud** environments.

- Ability to measure and report on product performance, using data to inform future product decisions and improvements.

- Experience working within a modern software engineering environment and the software development lifecycle.

- Experience in building and managing relationships and partnerships with key stakeholders.

- Experience in delivering outcomes in matrix organizations, influencing partners and stakeholders.

- Ability to facilitate collaboration across technical and non-technical teams and roles.

- Strong attention to detail and quality, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Experience in delivering within an agile development environment.

- Experience turning a vision into clear, tangible building blocks of a roadmap and have a clear definition of done.

- Ability to deal well with ambiguity, and ability to pave the way for things that have never been done before.

- Upper-intermediate English level.

**Nice to haves**

- Experience working in large complex organizations within a highly regulated industry.

- Experience in leveraging AI within your products.

**Perks**

- **Growth without limits:** build your skills through mentorship, internal TechTalks, challenging projects, and a dedicated annual learning budget

- **Competitive compensation:** get recognition that reflects your skills and impact, with regular performance and compensation reviews

- **Flexibility:** work 100% remotely with flexible hours that support focus, autonomy, and a healthy work rhythm

- **Meaningful, modern projects:** build impactful products using modern technologies alongside global teams and leading brands

- **Collaborative culture:** join a supportive environment with zero micromanagement where ideas are welcomed and contributions are recognized

- **Well-being & support:** access local well-being programs and people-focused support tailored to your location

**About Olly Olly**Olly Olly helps local service businesses grow through a combination of software, automation, and managed services. We are building products that simplify how small and mid-sized businesses manage their digital presence, lead flow, customer engagement, and growth operations.

We operate in a fast-moving environment where product, engineering, design, customer teams, and operational teams work closely together to deliver solutions that create measurable customer value. We are looking for a Product Manager who thrives in execution, brings structure to ambiguity, and can help turn strategy into well-defined, high-quality product delivery.

**Role Overview**The Product Manager will be responsible for translating product strategy and customer needs into clear, actionable work for engineering teams. This person will own backlog quality, ensure requirements are well defined, support cross-functional alignment, and help drive products from ideation through launch and iteration. This is a highly collaborative role for someone who is strong in execution, detail orientation, and stakeholder management. The right candidate knows how to balance speed with rigor, can work effectively across technical and non-technical teams, and is energized by improving processes while shipping meaningful product outcomes.

**What You’ll Do****Backlog Ownership and Delivery**

- Own and maintain a healthy, prioritized product backlog aligned to company priorities

- Break down initiatives into epics, stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation-ready requirements

- Partner closely with engineering to ensure work is clearly scoped, refined, and sequenced

- Ensure the team is working on the highest-impact opportunities with minimal ambiguity

- Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery follow-through

**Product Development Execution**

- Translate product direction into actionable requirements and user stories

- Ensure work moves through a clear product development lifecycle from discovery to launch

- Identify dependencies, risks, edge cases, and operational considerations early

- Partner with design to ensure workflows and requirements are grounded in real user needs

- Help drive launch readiness, user acceptance testing, and post-launch learning

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

- Work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Operations, and other internal stakeholders

- Gather input from stakeholders and customers to shape requirements and priorities

- Facilitate alignment when tradeoffs are needed across scope, timing, and quality

- Act as a connective tissue between strategy and execution across teams

**Quality and Process Improvement**

- Raise the bar on requirement quality, acceptance criteria, and release readiness

- Help create more discipline around prioritization, backlog health, documentation, and execution

- Support consistent processes for intake, triage, refinement, and launch planning

- Identify opportunities to improve how teams collaborate and deliver product outcomes

**What Success Looks Like**In this role, success means:

- Engineering teams have clear, well-defined work and fewer blockers caused by ambiguity

- Backlogs are healthy, prioritized, and aligned to business goals

- Stakeholders are informed, aligned, and engaged at the right points in the process

- Releases are better planned, better tested, and more predictable

- Product initiatives move faster with improved quality and less rework

- Customers receive solutions that are practical, valuable, and measurable

**Qualifications Required**

- 2 -5 years of experience in a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or similar product delivery role

- Experience working closely with software engineering teams in agile environments

- Strong ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional requirements

- Demonstrated skill in backlog management, prioritization, and cross-functional coordination

- Strong communication and organizational skills with high attention to detail

- Ability to operate in ambiguity and bring structure to fast-moving environments

- Comfortable balancing strategic context with hands-on execution

**Preferred**

- Experience in SaaS, vertical software, SMB technology, marketplaces, or workflow tools

- Experience supporting products that blend software and operational/service components

- Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Figma, and analytics platforms

- Experience working on customer-facing workflows such as lead management, communications, onboarding, or growth operations

- Exposure to AI-enabled products, automation, or internal operational tooling

- Deep customer empathy paired with strong product and design instincts.

- Genuine enthusiasm for AI, demonstrated through hands-on experimentation, building, prototyping, or independent projects, along with an active effort to stay current on emerging tools and research.

- Strong grasp of foundational LLM concepts and systems, including prompting, fine-tuning, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation, with the product judgment to turn them into dependable user experiences.

- Proficiency with modern prototyping and builder tools such as Cursor, Bolt, and Claude Code, along with ease in collaborative environments like Figma and Git.

- Strong command of data, experimentation, and decision-making, including the ability to recognize when data alone will not provide the answer.

- Ability to bridge technical and non-technical perspectives, translating complex systems into clear, compelling narratives.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with strong storytelling ability.

**Who You Are**

- Highly organized and execution-oriented

- Clear thinker who can simplify complexity

- Strong collaborator who builds trust across functions

- Comfortable being hands-on and detail-oriented without losing sight of business value

- Pragmatic, proactive, and solutions-focused

- Motivated by building products that solve real customer problems

**Why Join Olly Olly**This is an opportunity to help shape how product execution happens at a company that is evolving quickly and investing in better systems, stronger product discipline, and meaningful customer outcomes. You will have the chance to work across impactful initiatives, influence how teams operate, and help build products that directly support the growth of small businesses.

Olly Olly is hiring a Product Manager to help drive execution across our product organization. In this role, you will translate product strategy and customer needs into clear, prioritized work for engineering teams. You will own backlog quality, write detailed requirements, support refinement and launch planning, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-impact solutions.

We’re looking for someone who is highly organized, strong in product execution, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where structure, clarity, and collaboration matter. Ideal candidates have experience working with software teams in agile environments, managing backlogs, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and helping drive products from concept through launch. Experience in SaaS, SMB technology, workflow tools, marketplaces, or AI-enabled products is a plus.

Are you enthusiastic about shaping the future of digital products and web platforms for a global leader in the semiconductor industry?

Join the NXP.com Product Management team as a Product Manager for Digital Platforms, and help drive the strategy, evolution, and delivery of digital products that help customers engage with NXP solutions throughout their decision-making and development process.

As a Product Manager, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, investment priorities, and outcomes for a portfolio of digital products. This includes understanding customer and business needs, shaping product direction, defining how success will be measured, and prioritizing investments that create value for both customers and NXP. You will work across the organization with senior leaders, business stakeholders, customers, Sales, Marketing, and cross-functional partners to drive alignment, influence product decisions, and deliver meaningful outcomes for customers and the business.

The ideal candidate combines strong Product Owner and Agile delivery experience with broader Product Management responsibilities. You should be comfortable balancing strategy and execution, partnering with delivery teams to provide product direction, guide priorities, and maintain alignment throughout delivery.

Your work will connect customer problems, business objectives, and technical solutions to deliver digital experiences that support engineers and technology professionals worldwide. You will help drive the evolution of AI-enabled digital products and platforms while ensuring they continue to create value for customers and support business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Define and drive product strategy, vision, roadmap, and investment priorities for assigned products.

- Understand customer needs, business objectives, market trends, and technology opportunities to guide product decisions.

- Build alignment across senior leaders, business stakeholders, customers, and cross-functional teams while influencing product strategy, roadmap priorities, investment decisions, and business outcomes.

- Identify customer opportunities, define product outcomes, and establish success measures that demonstrate customer and business value.

- Use customer feedback, market insights, and product performance data to continuously refine product strategy, priorities, and investment decisions.

- Translate customer and business needs into product initiatives, roadmap investments, and strategic recommendations.

- Provide product direction and prioritization guidance throughout planning and delivery activities in Agile environments.

- Help drive the evolution of AI-enabled digital products and platforms, informed by industry trends, emerging technologies, and changing customer expectations.

- Evaluate product opportunities and investment priorities based on customer value, business impact, strategic alignment, and available evidence.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

- Proven experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar product leadership role for digital products, web applications, platforms, or websites.

- Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable customer and business outcomes.

- Strong experience working in Agile environments and partnering with business stakeholders, digital experience teams, engineering teams, architects, and other cross-functional organizations.

- Strong business acumen and the ability to connect product investments with customer and business outcomes.

- Experience translating customer needs and business opportunities into product priorities, investments, and delivery plans.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs) to support product discovery, research, analysis, communication, and decision-making.

- Good understanding of digital platforms, web technologies, user experience principles, analytics, and software development practices.

- Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence decisions across senior stakeholders without formal authority.

- Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable managing ambiguity and competing priorities.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to develop product narratives, strategy documents, and executive-level summaries.

**Education And Experience**

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Marketing, or a related field.

- Five or more years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, digital platforms, web applications, or related product-focused roles.

- Experience working with Agile teams across the product lifecycle, from discovery and planning through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.

- Exposure to the semiconductor industry, engineering workflows, technical products, or B2B technology environments is highly desirable.

- Experience with customer research, product analytics, experimentation, competitive analysis, or business-case development is a plus.

- Product Management, Product Ownership, Agile, or SAFe certifications are a plus.

**Corporate Overview**

**Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media**

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online **marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands**. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven **matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster.** They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

- The direct measurability of digital media.

- Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)

- The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

**Job Category**

QuinStreet Modernize Home Services is looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to lead the development of AI-powered customer acquisition experiences across conversational platforms, including ChatGPT, WhatsApp, RCS, and other AI assistants.

In this role, you will own the strategy and execution of products that enable our homeowners to discover contractors, request quotes, and connect with service providers directly through AI-driven conversations.

cargo:3858a8c9-0c64-4419-a783-f0e58e3618._descripcion: About CookUnity: Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. About the Team: The Revenue Engine team leads the company's revenue platform, which is the pricing, promotions, and payments engine that enables us to acquire, engage, and retain new eaters, seamlessly onboarding them onto the CookUnity platform. CookUnity has an incredible chef-driven story to tell—and a mind-blowing, must-taste product to introduce to the world. And because of this, the sky is the limit in crafting an alluring proposition and leveraging magnetic content. We have an incredible mission, as a product team, to not simply shake up the known Weekly Meal Plans and On-Demand Food Delivery categories, but usher in a new era of the chef-centric marketplace. The team will combine an exciting sign-up experience with an exciting and fulfilling first few weeks using CookUnity. The role: As a Sr. Product Manager for the CookUnity Product team, you will be at the forefront of enabling users to see the right pricing, promotions, and payment methods throughout the entire customer lifecycle and that their experience is consistently seamless. You will be responsible for identifying opportunities, hypothesizing solutions, creating and managing roadmaps, and working cross-functionally to execute growth initiatives. As a platform service, you will be at the center of new promotional capabilities, fraud and abuse mitigation, dynamic pricing models, and payment processing success rates. Responsibilities: Own, drive, and shape the revenue engine product strategy and roadmap, which includes increasing payment success rates, unlocking new promotional capabilities, and preventing fraud and abuse. Analyze payment trends and processing drop-off points to identify growth and retention opportunities Design and run A/B tests across payment and promotional touchpoints on web and app surfaces Establish clear intake, prioritization, and decision frameworks for stakeholder requests, ensuring transparency and consistency across teams. Lead the Revenue Engine Engineering squad to rapidly ship and iterate on improvements that meet team and company goals Work closely with Growth Marketing, Business Operations, Legal, Infrastructure, Security, and Shopper Experience teams to align platform innovations with company goals Drive execution on key product levers that drive growth and engagement for the overall ecosystem through cross-organizational partnership Write clear, efficient product specs and collect data on what works and what doesn’t Drive clear outcome metrics (e.g., payment success rates, conversion, early retention, promo abuse rate, etc) Surface insights and learnings regularly with key stakeholders and executive leadership Minimum Requirements: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Business, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. An MBA, a higher degree, and past experience in fraud and payment services are pluses. 7-10+ years of experience in product management, mostly building consumer-facing products and leading product teams. Passion for food, technology, and creating memorable user experiences. You have experience working in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment, leading strategic roadmap prioritization processes with senior leadership. Demonstrated ability to manage competing stakeholder requests, negotiate trade-offs, and set clear expectations with Growth and Lifecycle teams. Strong business and financial acumen; ability to evaluate promotional strategies based on ROI, margin impact, and long-term customer value. You have excellent communication skills, especially when it comes to articulating business logic to technical partners and inspiring a distributed team. You have technical proficiency with Product Management tools such as writing product briefs, user stories, performing analytics, building wireframes & prototypes, and QA testing. You have a strong data-driven and analytical mindset, which you use to set hypotheses, narrow in on opportunities, and drive impact on KPIs Experimentation experience in designing A/B and multivariate tests, synthesizing test results, and building frameworks to make data-informed launch decisions You are a DO-er. You get things done with others and across teams with a problem-solving mindset and avoid unnecessary conflict. Creative product ideation experience to apply growth tactics broadly to different product areas and think through detailed elements of a product experience Experience clearly communicating data-driven product insights to influence leadership direction Experience with data querying languages (e.g., SQL) and visualization tools such as Tableau and MixPanel Personal traits: Entrepreneurial with a high level of energy, and an unrelenting drive to succeed and win. Masters the stretch of strategic, big-picture thinking and hands-on, ‘getting things done’ mentality that generates immediate impact Collaborative and results-oriented leader, business partner and change agent who can lead through influence and possesses professional maturity and industry credibility. Superior communication, presentation and organizational skills. Highly intellectual – ability to think deeply, qualitatively and quantitatively about business problems, breaking down issues and presenting solutions. Strong mix of conceptual, data-driven, and analytical capabilities but also a hands-on and agile mentality Technologies You’ll Use Mixpanel, SiteSpect, and other solutions Snowflake, SQL, Looker, and internal data platforms Figma (with Design), Jira (with Eng), and Slack (with stakeholders and colleagues) Tableau Benefits 🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want 🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster. 💸 Get paid in USD ⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date 🐣 Paid Family leave of 12 weeks for primary caregiver and 6 weeks for secondary caregiver, fully paid 🎄 16 fully paid Argentine holidays 💸 Get paid in USD 🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises 🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach 🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider 🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical 🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. cargo:3858a8c9-0c64-4419-a783-f0e58e3618._descripcion: About Grupo QuintoAndar We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest housing platform in Latin America . Driven by our shared purpose of helping people love where they live , we build technology and solutions that simplify the entire housing journey, from renting to buying and selling. Operating across 6 countries (Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Peru, Ecuador, and Panama) and with a technology hub in Portugal , we bring together more than 3,100 people united by the challenge of transforming the real estate industry. Backed by top global investors such as SoftBank, General Atlantic, and Kaszek, we have raised over US$ 755 million and are valued at US$ 5.1 billion . We lead market transformation as pioneers in large-scale Artificial Intelligence applications for the real estate sector. Our platforms welcome over 50 million monthly visits, managing more than 350,000 active rental contracts and processing R$ 20 billion in annual transaction value. If you are looking to solve complex problems with autonomy, cutting-edge technology, and massive scale impact, come on in, the house is yours. To learn more about our story, visit: grupoquintoandar.com/ Location & Work Model We operate under a remote-first model, giving you full flexibility to work from anywhere in Brazil. For those who enjoy in-person moments, we offer access to our office in São Paulo and partner coworking spaces. In addition, we have the Work From Anywhere (WFA) program, which allows you to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 90 days a year. About the Team & The Challenge At QuintoAndar, Product Managers are at the core of our strategy, using technology and innovation to solve complex real-world problems and help people love where they live. We are looking for a highly analytical and strategic Senior Product Manager to lead high-impact workstreams and shape the future of our ecosystem. You will be responsible for driving the product vision, prioritizing big bets, and ensuring execution flows smoothly in a fast-paced, scale-up environment, directly impacting our transition into an AI-First company. Your Responsibilities Shape and execute the product vision and quarterly roadmap, translating complex business and user problems into scalable product solutions. Lead a cross-functional squad—integrating engineering, design, data, and operations—to ensure seamless execution and high-quality deliveries. Deep dive into execution and data, kicking off discovery streams, validating hypotheses, and testing new approaches before scaling. Influence business strategy and coordinate cross-company initiatives, managing complex stakeholder relationships and aligning expectations with senior leadership. Act as a role model for product excellence, bringing market insights, raising the bar for decision-making, and occasionally coaching more junior product team members. What We Are Looking For (Requirements) Solid product track record: proven experience as a Product Manager designing, building, and delivering high-impact, end-to-end digital solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: you are data-driven, comfortable navigating complex metrics, and capable of taking bold decisions based on factual data. Exceptional stakeholder management: demonstrated ability to gather inputs, handle pushbacks, and influence cross-functional teams and senior leaders. User-centric mindset: ability to uncover real user requirements (even the unarticulated ones) and advocate for the best experience. Fast-pace resilience: comfortable working with aggressive timelines and making quick adjustments in a fast-changing, high-growth environment. Nice to Haves Previous background in highly analytical positions, such as strategy consulting, data science, or operations, combined with hands-on product experience. Experience working on complex marketplaces, platform foundations, or AI-centric products. Advanced or fluent English skills. What Is Our Selection Process Like? We designed a transparent and straightforward journey focused on evaluating your technical and behavioral potential, while giving you the opportunity to get to know our teams and career paths: Application and Profile Review Interview with People Team Case Study Hiring Manager Interview Stakeholder Interview Offer & Welcome! Important: We review all applications individually and guarantee feedback for every candidate. All communication is conducted via email, so please make sure to allow emails from @quintoandar.com.br in your inbox. Benefits We offer a comprehensive package designed to support your health, well-being, family, and professional growth: Compensation: Competitive salary, PLR (Annual Performance Bonus). Health & Well-Being: Health Plan, Dental Plan, Life Insurance, Wellhub (Gympass), and QuintoCare (free psychological, legal, social, and financial support). Quality of Life: Meal and Food Vouchers, Birthday Day Off, Mother's Day, and Father's Day. Flexibility: Home Office Allowance and the Work From Anywhere (WFA) program. Family & Care: Childcare Allowance, Atypical Parenting Allowance, Extended Parental Leave, and Kit Leiturinha (children's book club). Education & Career: Partnerships and discounts with educational institutions. Diversity & Inclusion at Grupo QuintoAndar We value diversity and want everyone to feel welcome here , regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, ethnicity, origin, disability, religion, or any other characteristic. All our job openings are open to all individuals! You'll notice there are some diversity questions in the application form. For affirmative action roles, this information may be used to verify your alignment with the target audience for the opportunity. In such cases, it may be used for elimination purposes. For non-affirmative action roles, this data will be used anonymously, exclusively to monitor and improve our inclusion practices in the hiring process, and will have no impact on your application. Privacy and Data Protection The Grupo QuintoAndar operates in compliance with privacy and data protection laws, including, but not limited to, the Brazilian General Personal Data Protection Law (LGPD) (Law No. 13,709/2018), and ensures the security of your data. To learn more, please access our Privacy Notice for Candidates . For questions or to exercise your rights as a data subject, please contact us through our Service Channel .

cargo:d051de26-fd6b-40f7-828e-2469aacf38._descripcion:
**About Sift**
==============

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

**About the Role**
==================

Engineers rely on real-time alerts to know the moment something goes wrong.

You will own correctness test coverage for real-time alerting, from launch through every later release: proving that alerts fire when they should, and only then. That runs from the screens where users configure and review alerts to the backend services that evaluate them. Later, you will also cover our integration products: an edge database and viewer that runs on customer machines, our SDKs, command-line tool and data import pipelines. You will work with the Head of Quality Engineering and partner closely with the engineering teams that build these products.

**In This Role, You'll:**
=========================

* **Own alert correctness.** Build tests that prove alerts fire when they should, and only then, across conditions, thresholds, rolling windows and severities.
* **Build independent test data.** Generate realistic data and alert scenarios that do not depend on the code under test.
* **Own end-to-end UI testing.** Build and maintain browser tests for alert configuration, alert history and status views. Keep them fast, stable and trusted.
* **Validate what users see.** Add visual regression checks for status indicators, severity levels, previews and dashboards where they add signal without flakiness.
* **Test the APIs underneath.** Write integration tests for backend services against a real database, covering the main paths and the edge cases a design implies but does not spell out.
* **Test authorization thoroughly.** Verify who can view, create and change data under role-based, attribute-based and resource-scoped permissions, including the negative cases.
* **Test time-series evaluation.** Verify alert logic on real-time data, including late, missing and out-of-order data, backfill, and recovery after a backlog.
* **Compare old and new systems.** Validate a new system's results against the one it replaces using generated or anonymized data, and test outbound integrations such as webhooks.
* **Gate alert releases.** Define what correctness results block an alerts release, sign off on it, and report risks to the team.
* **Cover our integration products.** Map coverage gaps and build regression tests for an offline-first edge database and viewer, our SDKs, command-line tool and data imports, including install and upgrade testing in Sift test environments.
* **Train and guide a QE in another time zone.** Onboard a QE who runs regression overnight, and review their results.
* **Shape quality before code merges.** Review designs and test plans with engineers, find gaps by reading the code, and raise risks early in plain language.

**Required Skills:**
--------------------

* 5+ years in QA automation or SDET roles, covering both UI and backend testing.
* Strong Playwright and TypeScript skills. You have designed suites, not only written tests.
* Experience writing integration tests for backend services, ideally in Go, against a real database.
* Python for test data generation and scripting.
* Experience testing authorization and access control: roles, attributes and resource-level permissions (RBAC, ABAC).

Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing technology & professional services solutions company and industry leader in energy transformation.

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the energy industry. Throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

**Overview**The Cloud Platform Product Manager owns the product vision, roadmap, prioritization, adoption, and measurable outcomes for Quorum's internal cloud platform capabilities.

This role treats the Cloud Platform as an internal product. The Product Manager understands the needs of Product Engineering, Platform Operations, Cloud Operations, SRE, Security, and other platform consumers; translates those needs into a prioritized roadmap; and ensures platform capabilities are usable, scalable, governed, and delivering measurable business value.

The role does not serve as the principal platform architect and does not own day-to-day cloud operations. The Cloud Platform Product Manager determines what platform capabilities should be delivered, why they matter, who needs them, and how success will be measured, partnering with engineering and operations teams on how those capabilities are built and operated.

**Responsibilities****Product Strategy and Roadmap**

- Own and maintain the Cloud Platform product vision, strategy, and roadmap.

- Translate business, engineering, operational, security, and SaaS requirements into prioritized platform capabilities.

- Define product outcomes, milestones, dependencies, and success measures.

- Balance modernization, reliability, security, developer experience, cost optimization, and operational efficiency when prioritizing work.

- Maintain a clear backlog and ensure investment is tied to measurable business or operational outcomes.

**Internal Customer And Platform Experience**

- Treat Product Engineering, Platform Operations, Cloud Operations, SRE, DevOps, Security, and other internal teams as customers of the platform.

- Identify friction in provisioning, deployment, environment management, observability, security, lifecycle management, and support.

- Drive reusable, self-service platform capabilities rather than one-off solutions.

- Ensure platform capabilities have clear documentation, onboarding processes, ownership, and support models.

- Collect stakeholder feedback and use it to continuously improve the platform experience.

**Requirements And Prioritization**

- Gather and normalize requirements across product and platform teams.

- Convert business and operational problems into clear product requirements, epics, features, and acceptance criteria.

- Prioritize work using business impact, adoption, operational risk, security, cost, engineering effort, and strategic alignment.

- Establish transparent prioritization so stakeholders understand why capabilities are being developed and when they are expected.

- Manage dependencies across Cloud Platform Engineering, Security, Product Engineering, SRE, and Operations.

**Cloud Platform Adoption**

- Drive adoption of standardized platform capabilities across Quorum’s SaaS portfolio.

- Partner with product teams as they onboard to Quorum’s cloud platforms.

- Identify barriers to adoption and establish plans to address them.

- Ensure platform capabilities solve common needs rather than recreating product-specific infrastructure patterns.

- Measure adoption, utilization, satisfaction, and operational outcomes.

**Governance and Standardization**

- Partner with architecture, engineering, security, and operations teams to establish platform standards and guardrails.

- Drive standardization across cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, identity, networking, observability, naming, tagging, and lifecycle management.

- Ensure platform requirements incorporate security, compliance, data residency, and operational readiness.

- Promote automated guardrails and platform capabilities over manual governance processes where practical.

**Stakeholder and Executive Communication**

- Serve as the primary product interface between Cloud Platform stakeholders and delivery teams.

- Maintain visibility into roadmap progress, adoption, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.

- Communicate priorities and trade-offs clearly to technical and executive stakeholders.

- Facilitate roadmap reviews and platform planning discussions.

- Ensure stakeholder requests are evaluated against the overall platform strategy rather than creating isolated solutions.

- And other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

- 7+ years of experience in cloud technology, platform engineering, infrastructure, SaaS, DevOps, technical product management, or a related discipline.

- 3+ years of experience in product management, technical product ownership, platform leadership, or comparable responsibility.

- Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure; AWS experience is beneficial.

- Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, requirements, stakeholder priorities, and measurable outcomes.

- Ability to translate complex technical requirements into clear product outcomes and business value.

- Excellent written, verbal, and executive-level communication skills.

- Strong English communication skills for working across Quorum’s global organization.

- Fluent in English, both written and verbal

**Cloud Platform Technical Knowledge****Practical Understanding Of**

- Kubernetes

- Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

- Terraform and/or Crossplane

- GitOps and CI/CD

- Cloud networking

- Identity and access management

- Observability and telemetry

- Cloud security and governance

- SaaS architecture and operations

**Measures of Success**

- Increased adoption of standardized Cloud Platform capabilities.

- Reduced time to provision and onboard new SaaS environments.

- Reduced product-specific infrastructure and deployment patterns.

- Increased self-service and automation.

- Improved deployment consistency and reliability.

- Reduced operational toil.

- Improved adherence to security and governance standards.

- Improved internal developer and operator experience.

- Reduced infrastructure variance and cost.

- A clear, prioritized roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes.

**Role Boundaries**The Cloud Platform Product Manager owns product direction and outcomes. The role works through clear boundaries with the technical and operational teams responsible for architecture, delivery, and production operations.

**Staff Product Manager, B2C SaaS & Growth**

**Job Type: Part-Time or Full-Time (20–40 Hours/Week)**

**About the Role:**

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Staff Product Manager to drive product growth for a subscription-based SaaS business. This role is ideal for someone passionate about customer behavior, data-driven decision-making, and building products that improve activation, retention, and monetization.

You’ll work directly with the founder/CEO and collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams. You’ll have significant ownership of the product roadmap and the end-to-end user journey, with opportunities to expand into a broader leadership role based on your impact.

**Location & Work Arrangement:**

Work mode: 100% remote.

Open locations: United States (Eastern Time Zone only), Europe, Indonesia, Russia, and other eligible countries, subject to location and time-zone compatibility.

Engagement: Full-time (40 hours/week) or part-time (20 hours/week).

**Key Responsibilities;**

* Own the product growth strategy and roadmap, connecting customer needs with business objectives.
* Develop and execute strategies to reduce voluntary and involuntary churn.
* Optimize onboarding and activation to help users experience product value faster.
* Reduce time-to-value by identifying and removing friction throughout the user journey.
* Improve first-week engagement through behavioral triggers, product education, lifecycle messaging, and feature adoption initiatives.
* Drive monetization and subscription revenue growth through continuous product optimization.
* Conduct regular customer interviews, churn interviews, cancellation surveys, and product discovery research.
* Analyze customer behavior, identify growth opportunities, and translate insights into actionable product initiatives.
* Design, run, and evaluate experiments to measure the impact of product changes.
* Define and monitor key metrics, including activation, retention, churn, conversion, customer lifetime value (LTV), average revenue per user (ARPU), and payback period.
* Work closely with Engineering and Infrastructure teams to prioritize, deliver, and measure product improvements.
* Establish a consistent product and engineering execution rhythm, ensuring decisions are driven by data and customer insights.

**Requirements:**

* 7–10+ years of product experience: Extensive experience across different product roles, preferably in Product-Led Growth (PLG) environments within subscription-based SaaS businesses.
* 7+ years of experience improving activation and reducing churn: Demonstrated experience using customer interviews and product experiments to improve activation and reduce churn. Candidates must provide specific examples supported by measurable results and numbers.
* 7+ years of data-driven product experience: Strong experience working closely with data, using product analytics tools to analyze user behavior, identify opportunities, and guide product decisions.
* 7+ years of user-journey optimization experience: Proven experience mapping the B2C user journey, breaking it down into meaningful segments, and identifying opportunities to improve the overall customer experience.
* Strong PLG and subscription SaaS background: Experience with self-serve subscription products that allow users to register, try, and purchase independently without requiring interaction with a sales team.
* B2C SaaS subscription experience: Strongly preferred. General B2C experience alone, without relevant SaaS subscription experience, is not sufficient. B2B SaaS experience is also acceptable when the product follows a genuine self-serve PLG model.
* Customer research and experimentation: Experience conducting customer interviews, identifying customer pain points, and running experiments to validate improvements and measure their impact.
* Subscription analytics: Strong understanding of subscription metrics, including retention cohorts, retention curves, churn segmentation, customer lifetime value (LTV), average revenue per user (ARPU), and payback period.
* Fluent English: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills are essential.
* Hands-on execution: Ability to own product strategy while remaining actively involved in product development, analytics, experimentation, and execution.

**Bonus Qualifications:**

* Relevant industry experience: Experience in VPN, VPS, hosting, cloud storage, or consumer infrastructure SaaS.
* Product leadership experience: 2+ years in a management role, such as Product Lead, Head of Product, or Director of Product.
* Informal team leadership: Experience leading teams or driving cross-functional initiatives without holding an official management title.
* Marketing and acquisition exposure: Experience with marketing, customer acquisition, or growth initiatives.

**What We Offer:**

* 100% remote work with flexibility to work from different locations worldwide, subject to location and time-zone requirements.
* Flexible engagement options: 20 or 40 hours per week.
* Direct collaboration with the founder/CEO and significant ownership of product strategy and execution.
* The opportunity to shape the product roadmap and make a measurable impact on business growth.
* Potential to expand into a broader product leadership role based on performance and business needs.
* A collaborative, international team environment.
* Professional growth through exposure to multiple areas of the business.
* Mentorship and direct collaboration with the founder/CEO.

**How to Apply:**

If you have a strong background in product-led growth, subscription SaaS, and data-driven product optimization, we’d love to hear from you.

Please apply with your CV and highlight your relevant experience, including measurable results in activation improvement, churn reduction, product analytics, and B2C user-journey optimization.

Pay: $230,000.00 - $250,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Life insurance

Work Location: Remote

**Blacksmith Agency**

- Design

- Full time, your only job

**About The Role**Blacksmith Agency builds websites for clients across the US. As Product Design Systems Designer at Blacksmith, you build the Figma design systems our team ships every client site from: tokens, variables, modes and component libraries that developers build from without asking you questions.

This is a full-time, in-house seat on our team, and it has to be your only job. If you run freelance clients, a studio or agency side work, or plan to keep them, this role is not a fit.

**What You Will Own**

- Token architecture in Figma: variables, modes and semantic naming, from primitives to semantic to component level.

- Component libraries that hold up across an entire site, not just a homepage.

- Handoff and documentation that let a developer or a build pipeline execute the system without questions.

- Several client brands at once, each distinct, with the same structure underneath.

**What You Bring**

- 4+ years as a product, UI or design systems designer, ideally on an in-house team.

- A design system you personally built in Figma with variables, modes and tokens, and can walk us through in detail.

- Experience handing a system to developers and keeping Figma and code in step.

- Strong spoken English. You will present and defend your system on live calls with a US team.

- Full-time availability overlapping US business hours.

**Not a fit if**

- You freelance or run a studio and would keep clients alongside this job.

- Your work is mainly page layouts or marketing pages, without tokens or variables.

**How To Apply**Apply in two minutes at the link, then take a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment with the same email. Qualified applicants then do a 20 minute recorded interview in English about the systems they have built.

**Sobre Coderio**

Coderio diseña y entrega soluciones digitales escalables para empresas globales. Con una base técnica sólida y una mentalidad orientada al producto, nuestros equipos lideran proyectos de software complejos desde la arquitectura hasta la ejecución. Valoramos la autonomía, la comunicación clara y la excelencia técnica. Colaboramos estrechamente con equipos y socios internacionales, construyendo tecnología que genera impacto.

\uD83C\uDF0D Más información: http://coderio.com

**Qué buscamos**

Buscamos un **Senior Fullstack Developer (Node.js & React.js)** para sumarse a nuestro equipo regional en modalidad 100% remota desde LATAM. En este rol, serás clave en el diseño de arquitecturas escalables, la creación de experiencias de usuario de alto impacto y la evolución de nuestros procesos mediante metodologías avanzadas de desarrollo asistido por Inteligencia Artificial.

### **Main Stack**

* **Frontend:** React.js (v18+), TypeScript, Vite, Material UI / Tailwind CSS, HTML5/CSS3.
* **Backend:** Node.js, TypeScript, Express / NestJS, RESTful APIs, GraphQL.
* **Databases:** Relacionales (PostgreSQL, MySQL / RDS) y NoSQL (MongoDB / DynamoDB).
* **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS/EKS), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform / CloudFormation, CI/CD (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI).
* **Version Control & Quality:** Git, Jest / React Testing Library.
* **Methodologies & AI:** Agile (Scrum / Kanban), Spec-Driven Development (SDD), integración y asistencia con IA Generativa.

### **Main Responsibilities**

* **Desarrollo Fullstack End-to-End:** Diseñar, implementar y evolucionar arquitecturas escalables, desarrollando interfaces web dinámicas en **React.js con TypeScript** y servicios robustos en el backend con **Node.js**.
* **Gestión de Bases de Datos:** Diseñar esquemas eficientes, optimizar consultas e interactuar con bases de datos relacionales (**PostgreSQL, SQL / RDS**) y entornos NoSQL.
* **Infraestructura y CI/CD:** Gestionar y aprovisionar recursos en la nube (**AWS**) mediante Infraestructura como Código (**Terraform**), implementar contenedores (**Docker, Kubernetes**) y automatizar pipelines de **CI/CD** (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI) para despliegues continuos.
* **Desarrollo e Ingeniería Asistida por IA:** Incorporar metodologías de desarrollo guiado por especificaciones (SDD) y estructurar prompts avanzados para guiar herramientas de IA en la producción y optimización ágil de código.
* **Calidad y Buenas Prácticas:** Garantizar la seguridad, estabilidad y rendimiento del código propio y asistido por IA mediante la creación de suites de pruebas unitarias y de integración (**Jest / Testing Library**) y revisiones de código (*code reviews*).
* **Consultoría Técnica y Colaboración Ágil:** Actuar como nexo entre los requerimientos de negocio y la ejecución técnica, traduciendo necesidades funcionales en arquitecturas eficientes dentro de un marco de trabajo **Agile**.

### **Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experiencia:** +5 años de experiencia comprobable en desarrollo de software Fullstack.
* **Sólido dominio técnico:** Dominio experto de **Node.js, React.js y TypeScript**.
* **Bases de Datos & Cloud:** Experiencia en modelado y consultas con **PostgreSQL / SQL**, así como conocimientos prácticos en **AWS**, integración de pipelines **CI/CD** y gestión de contenedores con **Docker**.

cargo:8f61b903-ae7b-4b87-965d-1174fab0c7._descripcion:
Join OnLogic as our Marketing Manager EU (full time) and lead our European marketing efforts to achieve our ambitious growth goals. This role owns the EU marketing strategy, budget, and execution — from demand generation and performance marketing through to the sales, partner, and content relationships that make the function work. You will set priorities for the team in alignment with the commercial and regional strategy, represent EU marketing in regional and global leadership forums, and be the accountable owner for how marketing contributes to OnLogic's EU growth ambitions through 2027 and beyond. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set direction and also execute directly where the team's capacity requires it.

**On an average day, you will...**

- Develop the EU marketing strategy in alignment with global and European goals.

- Review campaign and channel performance (paid media, email, organic) against cost-per-lead and pipeline targets, and adjust budget allocation across markets accordingly

- Check in with the EU Sales leadership team on pipeline health, named-account progress, and where marketing support is needed this week

- Direct and coach the team members who report to you — covering sales alignment/ABM, paid media execution, lifecycle/email marketing, and marketing coordination — and unblock whatever's in their way

- Brief or follow up with the Global Marketing Hub (content, creative, and the transcreation agency) on what EU markets need next, and chase down anything that's stuck

- Track progress on localized, market-specific initiatives — new country launches, translated content, campaign rollouts — and resolve sequencing issues before they become costly

- Coordinate with channel and ecosystem partners on joint marketing activity, co-branded materials, or upcoming events

- Prepare or review reporting on marketing's contribution to revenue, pipeline, and retention for your Regional Leader and Global Marketing counterparts

- Make budget trade-off calls — where the next euro of spend goes, and what gets deprioritized — within your delegated authority

- Represent EU marketing's perspective in cross-functional planning conversations with Sales, Partnerships, and the Global Marketing team

- Step in personally on execution — writing a brief, reviewing campaign copy, troubleshooting a localized landing page — when the team's workload requires it

- Collaborate with the VP of Marketing to manage lead generation metrics and budget allocation.

- Provide mentorship and professional development opportunities for the team.

- Continuously build and develop the European marketing team to meet projected growth demands.

**The team you will be joining:**We are a multi-talented, omnichannel marketing and ecommerce team consisting of digital marketers, writers, designers, communications experts and planners and endeavor to show the world why OnLogic is the first choice in Industrial and Edge Computing. You'll find us developing marketing campaigns, creating design-driven experiences for our audience, curating our social media channels, penning website content and laughing daily at each other's terrible jokes. We are a collaborative crew that works hard to position the brand, generate demand and deliver a delightful customer experience.

Learn more about Life at OnLogic: www.onlogic.com/careers

**Requirements****Required Experience**

- 8+ years in B2B marketing, with at least 3 years in a role owning budget, strategy, and a team simultaneously

- Direct experience in performance marketing / demand generation (paid media, SEO, lifecycle/email) — this role will execute hands-on, not just direct others, particularly while the team is building out

- Experience working within or alongside a hub-and-spoke or center-of-excellence marketing model, where a central team produces brand/content assets and a regional team localizes and activates them — or clear evidence of having operated effectively within a similarly federated structure

- Experience in a multi-country European go-to-market context — managing or coordinating marketing across more than one EU market simultaneously, with an understanding of how localization, language, and buying behavior differ by country

- B2B technology, industrial, or hardware sector experience strongly preferred, given OnLogic's embedded/industrial computing product line (edge servers, panel PCs) and vertical focus on specific industries

- Experience managing or influencing channel/partner marketing relationships, given the scale of partner-revenue growth this role supports

**Skills & Competencies**

- Budget ownership and trade-off decision-making — comfortable allocating and reallocating spend across channels and markets under revenue pressure, not just executing an approved plan

- Working fluency with intent-data/ABX platforms (e.g., 6Sense or equivalent) and CRM-integrated marketing operations

- Strong cross-functional stakeholder management — this role interfaces with Sales, a Global Marketing Hub, Partnerships, and Regional leadership concurrently, each with different priorities

- Team leadership and coaching — the role directly manages a team spanning sales alignment, performance media, and coordination functions with different skill sets

- Data fluency — able to read and act on CPL, CPA, pipeline conversion, and retention metrics without needing them translated by an analyst

**Languages**

- Business-level English & Dutch is required

- A third major EU business language (German, French, Italian, or Spanish) strongly preferred, given the markets this role directly touches (DACH, Benelux, France, Italy, Spain)

**Who We Are**OnLogic is growing, and we want to give you the same opportunity to grow in your career! We design and manufacture specialized computers and hardware solutions for companies (B2B) all over the world, helping them to make the seemingly impossible possible. Our computers are designed to work where others would fail, and it's our vision to be the first choice in industrial computing. To make that vision a reality, we've built a team of ambitious problem solvers, guided by the company's core values of Open, Fair, Innovative and Independent. We have an open office, open salaries and strive to be fair and transparent in our decision making. We encourage input and feedback from every member of our team and look to improve ourselves and our business every single day. OnLogic is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

To learn more about our values, our mission and what it's like to work at OnLogic, visit www.onlogic.com/careers.

**Benefits**The salary range for this role is € 6.000,- to € 8.000,- per month. We determine final compensation based on conversations with applicants and their experience in similar roles. Besides a base salary we will offer you a comprehensive Benefits package which includes:

- 28 vacation days

- Premium free pension scheme

- Travel reimbursement

- An annual Profit Share Bonus

- A personal development plan created to help you (and us) grow

You will play a key role in improving the entire B2B marketing funnel, from initial contact acquisition to lead qualification and sales conversion. Develop and execute integrated, multi-channel demand generation strategies that increase brand awareness, prospect engagement, marketing-qualified leads (MQLs), sales pipeline, and revenue. Plan, launch, and manage campaigns across email marketing, paid media, webinars, events, content marketing, SEO, retargeting, and lead nurturing programs. Align campaign strategies with target audiences, buyer personas, customer journeys, purchasing stages, and broader business objectives. Create, write, and optimize marketing assets, including email campaigns, landing pages, digital advertisements, webinar promotions, and lead nurturing content. Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimize targeting, messaging, creative assets, and channel investments based on engagement, conversion, and pipeline results. Apply SEO principles and search-intent insights to improve campaign visibility, content relevance, and demand generation performance. Track, analyze, and report on key marketing metrics, including contact acquisition, MQL generation, pipeline contribution, conversion rates, campaign attribution, and return on investment. Ensure accurate campaign tagging, tracking, and measurement across marketing technology platforms. Collaborate with Revenue Operations (RevOps) and other stakeholders to strengthen attribution models, improve reporting accuracy, and optimize lead management processes. Manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously while ensuring consistent execution and alignment with business goals. Balance strategic marketing leadership with direct involvement in campaign development, platform management, content creation, and performance analysis. Requirements: Minimum of 6 years of professional experience in B2B demand generation, digital marketing, integrated marketing, or a closely related field. Proven track record of developing and executing integrated, multi-channel demand generation campaigns that generate qualified leads and contribute to measurable pipeline growth. Strong understanding of the B2B marketing funnel, including contact acquisition, lead scoring, MQL generation, lead nurturing, pipeline conversion, and lead recycling strategies. Hands-on experience managing digital marketing campaigns across paid advertising, email marketing, webinars, content marketing, retargeting, and automated nurture programs. Strong analytical capabilities, with experience measuring campaign performance, marketing attribution, pipeline contribution, conversion rates, and ROI. Practical experience using marketing automation platforms and CRM systems to manage campaigns, track leads, and measure marketing effectiveness. Excellent project management and campaign coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, taking ownership of campaigns from initial planning through implementation, analysis, and optimization. Excellent problem-solving and organizational abilities, with a proactive, results-oriented approach to improving campaign performance. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with HubSpot or comparable marketing automation platforms. Background in legal technology, SaaS, professional services, or B2B technology environments. Experience collaborating with Revenue Operations or Sales Operations teams on marketing attribution, lead management, and performance reporting. Knowledge of lead scoring frameworks, funnel conversion optimization, and campaign attribution models. Experience developing, writing, and optimizing marketing content across multiple digital channels. Familiarity with technology-driven legal services and the marketing challenges associated with complex B2B offerings. Comprehensive healthcare and employee benefits package. 401(k) retirement savings plan. Employee wellbeing programs. Flexible paid time off. Remote working arrangements and flexibility. Professional development and career advancement opportunities. People-focused and collaborative workplace culture. Opportunity to work with innovative, cutting-edge technology in the legal services industry. Inclusive work environment that values diversity, accessibility, and equal employment opportunities.

 - Comfort working fast in a startup and doing the work yourself


NICE TO HAVE

**Supporting Education Group** is the UK’s leading education services platform, providing the technology, expertise and resources that help schools, trusts and education organisations deliver high‑quality learning for all.

**About the role**  
We're looking for a commercially minded **Partnerships Marketing Manager** to drive growth across LMP Education's established network of schools and Multi-Academy Trusts.

Working closely with our Sales and Marketing teams, you'll lead an **Account-Based Marketing (ABM)** strategy that strengthens partner relationships, increases apprenticeship engagement, and expands the adoption of workforce development programmes across key accounts.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic marketer who enjoys combining data, insight, and creativity to deliver measurable results. You'll create targeted campaigns, build compelling customer journeys through HubSpot, and develop content that helps education leaders solve workforce challenges around recruitment, retention, and staff development.

**Key responsibilities(this list is not exhaustive)**

* Developing and delivering ABM campaigns for existing partner schools and trusts
* Creating personalised marketing plans for priority accounts
* Driving engagement through email, digital marketing, automation, webinars, events, and thought leadership content
* Using customer insights and performance data to identify growth opportunities
* Building nurture journeys and campaign reporting through HubSpot
* Producing impactful case studies, success stories, and customer communications
* Partnering with Sales and account teams to increase programme uptake and strengthen long-term partnerships

**This role offers the chance to make a real impact within education while helping shape the growth strategy of an ambitious and purpose-driven organisation.**  
  
**About you**  
You'll be an experienced B2B marketer with a passion for building strong relationships and delivering commercially focused campaigns that drive customer growth and retention.

You'll bring:

* 5+ years' experience in **B2B Marketing, Account-Based Marketing, Customer Marketing, or Growth Marketing**
* A proven track record of delivering campaigns that generate measurable growth and engagement
* Experience working closely with Sales or Account Management teams to achieve commercial objectives
* Hands-on experience with **HubSpot**, including marketing automation, email marketing, segmentation, and reporting
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into actionable insights
* Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills
* Outstanding communication and content creation abilities

**You'll thrive in this role if you are:**

* Relationship-focused and customer-centric
* Commercially aware with a strong growth mindset
* Strategic in your thinking but hands-on in execution
* Results-driven and motivated by measurable outcomes
* Collaborative, proactive, and adaptable
* Confident influencing stakeholders and building credibility with senior decision-makers

Experience within the education sector, apprenticeships, or workforce development is advantageous, but not essential.

**Benefits that actually make a difference**

️**28 days’ holiday + bank holidays** plus an extra day for every year you stay (up to 33) and option to buy **up to 5 more days** (all pro-rata for part time roles)

**Enhanced paid family leave** (after probation pass) to help new parents and long-term carers

**Medical cash plan** (after probation pass) making contributions towards everyday health costs such as dental, optical and prescriptions

**Life insurance from day one** (up to **4x salary**) PLUS **free wellbeing support** with access to 24/7 GP, counselling, medical second opinions, physiotherapy and lifestyle coaching

**Pension contributions from both of us** (after 3 months)

**Discounts** access to different options to help your money go further

**Because great people deserve great benefits.**

Together, we will continue to advance our passion for education and build brighter futures for all.

**About Healthy Gamer**

If you grew up on the Internet like us, you know mental health is more important than ever. But many people face obstacles when seeking traditional mental health care, like finding the right support or having the right insurance.

At Healthy Gamer, we think modern mental health care should be inclusive and affordable. Our coaching service has helped over 13,000 people across 77 countries since it launched in November 2019. Our movement is gaining traction, putting us in the top 0.1% of Twitch streamers and the top 1% of YouTube channels. And we're working on even more resources to help people find a way forward when they need it.

We've made an impact in the gaming community, but that's not where our mission ends. We want to change how people think about and deal with mental health, and we're looking for passionate people to help us get there. We are building teams of the best and the brightest in mental wellness, and we are having fun doing it.

**The role:**

We are seeking an experienced Marketing Manager to support content, community, and program marketing at the Healthy Gamer Institute (HGI).

In this US-based, fully-remote role, you will own key marketing and engagement work across content creation, social media, community management, email campaigns, and outreach, with a focus on growing awareness and engagement for our continuing education (CE) and certification programs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Produce thought leadership and SEO-driven content, including blogs, white papers, and lead capture materials that align with best practices and industry trends.
* Plan, draft, and send email communications for new cohorts, continuing education programs, community newsletters, and general updates. Audiences include waitlist and newsletter subscribers across the HGI ecosystem and, at times, the broader Healthy Gamer audience.
* Manage the strategy, scheduling, and analytics for HGI social media, posting several times a week on LinkedIn and other professional channels for aspiring and current coaches. Track analytics and recommend ways to grow engagement.
* Build and engage the HGI community, and pilot new ways to connect with it, including webinars, live events, or other creative initiatives.
* Lead outreach and partnerships with conferences, schools, and organizations, including speaking engagements. Handle intake, route inbound inquiries, and follow up as needed.
* Manage contacts in the CRM, segment audiences, and send targeted messaging.
* Research, synthesize, and translate insights into content, campaigns, and marketing strategy.
* Execute projects with strong organizational skills, keeping timelines on track and aligned with long-term marketing goals.
* Shape and improve HGI's online presence, using insights from the community to improve website content, design, and user experience.
* Identify opportunities and propose strategies to expand HGI's reach and impact, including new channels, advertising, partnerships, and speakerships.

**Who You Are:**

* A strategic thinker who can plan long-term while executing day-to-day initiatives.
* A strong writer and communicator who can adapt tone and style across channels.
* Comfortable managing multiple projects independently.
* Confident working across both B2C (via industry partnerships) and B2B contexts.
* Social media savvy and community-minded.

**This role is not responsible for:**

* Setting company-wide marketing strategy or brand identity
* The product roadmap
* Creating multimedia and video
* Executive and crisis communications

**Qualifications**

**Must have:**

* 7+ years of experience in growth marketing, communications, or a similar field.
* Experience working with continuing education (CE) courses or educational platforms.
* Strong writing and editorial skills, with experience producing long-form content (blogs, white papers, thought leadership) and short-form marketing copy.
* Experience growing and engaging communities on social platforms such as LinkedIn, with comfort analyzing performance metrics and turning data into clear recommendations.
* Collaborative mindset, with experience working cross-functionally across Marketing, Healthy Gamer Institute, and external partners.

**Nice to have:**

* Strong interest in mental health, digital trends, and emerging technologies like AI.
* Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM platform.
* Knowledge of SEO and AEO best practices, keyword research, and performance-driven content strategy.

**Why you'll love this work**
-----------------------------

* **Remote from day one.** Work from anywhere in the US, with a team that knows how to collaborate online.
* **Real impact.** Your launches help people find mental health support, often for the first time.
* **A team that listens.** Your recommendations shape how we bring products to market.
* **Room to grow.** You'll help scale our marketing, including new B2B opportunities.

**1- Who are we?**PARIS/64 is one of the fastest-growing Spanish women’s fashion brands online, with a strong international presence. We are a young and dynamic team of digital natives, with a clear focus on scalability and working towards objectives. Founded in 2019, we manufacture our own products in Spain, taking care of every step of the process with a firm commitment to excellence and responsibility.

**2- Job description. What will your mission be?**We are looking for an E-commerce Growth Manager with **deep technical specialisation in digital marketing and e-commerce**, in a **full-time, on-site position** at our offices in **Madrid or Zaragoza**.

We are not looking for a generalist or a strategic director. We are looking for a **specialist who masters the tools and the data first-hand**: someone who builds, measures, tests and optimises, and who can audit any agency with superior technical judgement. The role is accountable for the **growth and profitability of online revenue**, reports directly to management and works closely with Marketing (Brand & Content, Influencers, and Events & PR).

Main responsibilities:

**Paid media**

- Technically lead Meta Ads and Google Ads strategy and execution together with the agency: account structure, bidding, budgets, audiences, and Advantage+ and Performance Max campaigns.

- Design and run an ongoing creative testing system, including amplifying influencer content through paid partnership ads.

- Allocate investment by channel based on MER, CAC and contribution margin, not on platform-reported ROAS.

**Measurement and data**

- Ensure reliable end-to-end tracking: GA4, Google Tag Manager (client and server-side), Meta Conversions API and Google Enhanced Conversions.

- Build the dashboards and weekly reporting: revenue, MER, CAC, conversion rate, average order value, repeat purchase and customer lifetime value.

- Design incrementality tests to measure the real impact of each channel.

**Conversion and website**

- Lead conversion rate optimisation on Shopify: funnel analysis, A/B tests, product pages, navigation and checkout.

- Manage the e-commerce team, steering website operations towards growth: commercial calendar, launches and merchandising.

**CRM and retention**

- Develop CRM in Klaviyo or similar: automations, segmentation, email and SMS, repeat purchase and customer value, connecting store customers with the website.

**3- Requirements**

- At least 6 years of hands-on experience in growth, performance marketing or e-commerce at DTC brands, ideally in fashion, luxury or lifestyle.

- Direct management of significant paid media budgets, with proven results in revenue and profitability.

- Expert command of Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Shopify and Klaviyo or equivalent tools.

- Advanced technical knowledge of tracking and attribution: server-side tagging, Conversions API, attribution models and their limitations.

- Very strong analytical skills: funnels, cohorts, LTV, CAC, MER and profitability analysis by channel. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets.

- Hands-on: used to working directly in the tools, not just supervising.

- Experience auditing and managing agencies.

- High level of English (C1 or above), essential: you will work daily with our international markets (Europe, USA and Japan), partners and suppliers in English.

- Nice to have: SQL, BigQuery, Looker Studio, CRO and testing tools, international e-commerce experience and experience at brands with physical stores.

**4- Selection process**The process will include a **technical case study** based on real PARIS/64 data: an account diagnosis and a proposal of concrete actions. We will especially value technical depth and the ability to reach actionable conclusions from data.

**5- What do we offer?**

- Permanent contract, full time.

- On-site position at our offices in Madrid or Zaragoza.

- Fixed + variable compensation linked to online revenue and profitability targets.

- Become the technical reference for a key business area at a brand in full international growth, with real autonomy and responsibility.

If you want to join a brand in full international expansion and become the technical reference for its online growth, we would love to meet you!
