We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform. Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality. About the Role We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager, AI & Data to lead positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for Bask Health's AI-enabled capabilities, data intelligence tools, and technical platform features. Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place. As a Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager, you'll help customers understand how AI, data intelligence, and automation can support the businesses they operate on Bask Health. You'll work closely with product managers, software engineers, AI engineers, data stakeholders, sales, customer success, and company leadership to translate technical capabilities into clear customer value. This role requires someone who is comfortable working with complex software products and can understand how technical systems function without relying entirely on high-level marketing descriptions. You'll help explain how these tools can support operational efficiency, improve access to business information, and simplify complex workflows. You'll collaborate with technical teams to understand how features operate, what their limitations are, and which customer problems they are designed to solve. You'll develop messaging that communicates product value accurately while avoiding unsupported claims about automation, intelligence, reliability, or outcomes. You'll analyze competing platforms and emerging product capabilities to identify opportunities for differentiation. You'll partner with product teams to prepare launches, develop customer-facing narratives, and determine how new technical functionality should be introduced to the market. You'll create technical product overviews, launch briefs, sales enablement materials, demonstrations, and educational resources. You'll also work with customer success teams to help existing customers understand and adopt relevant AI and data capabilities. Because Bask Health operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll need to approach AI positioning carefully and collaborate with appropriate stakeholders when messaging touches clinical, patient, or pharmacy workflows. You'll help establish consistent terminology for AI, analytics, and automation across marketing materials and customer communications. You'll measure the effectiveness of product marketing initiatives using customer feedback, launch outcomes, adoption trends, and commercial performance indicators. We're looking for someone who combines technical curiosity, strong product marketing judgment, clear communication, and the ability to take ownership of initiatives from early research through launch and measurement. What You'll Do Own technical product marketing strategy for Bask Health's AI and data capabilities. Develop positioning and messaging for AI-enabled platform features. Create clear value propositions for data intelligence and automation tools. Translate technical functionality into understandable customer benefits. Build messaging frameworks for AI-powered product experiences. Develop product narratives for business intelligence and data exploration capabilities. Support positioning for BaskQL and related conversational analytics functionality, as applicable. Explain how AI-enabled tools support merchant and operational workflows. Partner with AI engineers to understand feature architecture and technical limitations. Collaborate with data stakeholders to understand analytics capabilities and underlying information. Work with product managers to define go-to-market strategies for technical features. Lead cross-functional launch planning for AI and data product releases. Conduct customer research to understand AI adoption needs and concerns. Identify customer questions related to accuracy, reliability, transparency, and usability. Develop messaging that accurately communicates supported AI functionality. Coordinate technical validation of product claims with relevant stakeholders. Research competing AI-enabled SaaS platforms and data intelligence products. Develop competitive positioning and differentiation materials. Create technical product presentations, feature overviews, and launch briefs. Build sales enablement resources for technical product conversations. Support product demonstrations and customer education initiatives. Partner with customer success teams to improve AI feature adoption. Develop educational materials explaining new automation and analytics capabilities. Collaborate with growth and marketing teams on technical product campaigns. Support website and landing page messaging for AI and data products. Establish consistent technical terminology across customer-facing materials. Define launch objectives and evaluate product marketing effectiveness. Present technical product marketing strategies, research findings, and recommendations to leadership.
